plugins.description: 本地环境管理
plugins.readme_text:
# ployenv

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

A portable, single-binary version manager for local language runtimes —
**Node.js, Java, Go and Python** — with nothing to install and nothing to
configure.

No installer, no account, no licence checks, and **no changes to your system
environment**. Drop one executable anywhere; its runtimes and settings live next
to it.

```console
$ ployenv install node@20
$ ployenv use node@20
$ ployenv shell
```

## Why ployenv

- **Non-invasive** — never edits the system `PATH`, `.npmrc`, `pip.ini` or the
  registry. Activating a version affects one terminal window only.
- **Explicit** — official sources by default. ployenv adopts an existing
  installation only when you ask it to, and never guesses.
- **Predictable** — the effective version comes from a project file (`.ployenv`,
  plus `.nvmrc`, `.tool-versions` and friends) or from one global default, and
  `PLOYENV_<LANG>_VERSION` overrides both. Nothing ever falls back to "some
  installed version".
- **Portable** — a single ~7.5 MB static binary with zero third-party
  dependencies. Move the folder, keep everything.
- **Scriptable** — `--json` output is pure ASCII (non-ASCII characters are
  escaped as `\uXXXX`), so it survives any console code page.

## Install

Windows 10/11 is the primary target; Linux and macOS (amd64/arm64) are built and
validated on native runners by CI. The macOS binaries are unsigned and unnotarized,
so the first run may need `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine`. Building needs **Go 1.22+**.

```powershell
go build -ldflags "-s -w" -o dist/ployenv.exe ./cmd/ployenv
```

Or, if script execution is allowed:

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\build.ps1 -Test
```

Then put the binary on your `PATH`, for example `D:\PloyEnv\ployenv.exe`.

## Quick start

```powershell
# see what is available
ployenv available node --limit 5

# install a runtime (22, lts and latest all work)
ployenv install node@20
ployenv install java@21
ployenv install go@1.24
ployenv install python@3.12

# record a default, then inspect
ployenv use node@20
ployenv current
ployenv list

# activate it in this terminal only
ployenv shell
```

Pin a project by adding a `.ployenv` file next to its source:

```ini
node=20.20.2
java=21
go=1.24
python=3.12
```

`ployenv use node@20 --project` writes or updates this file for you.

## Documentation

The full command reference, configuration and troubleshooting guide lives in
**[docs/manual.md](docs/manual.md)** ([简体中文](docs/manual.zh-CN.md)).

Highlights:

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `ployenv support` | List supported runtimes |
| `ployenv available <lang>` | Installable versions |
| `ployenv doctor` | Paths, writability and resolution report |
| `ployenv config` | Show or change every setting |

Run `ployenv --help` for the built-in summary.

## Roadmap

**Done**

- [x] Portable data directory, one-time base configuration
- [x] Node.js, Java, Go and Python, each described by a built-in Spec
- [x] Mirror fallback, and interrupt-safe cleanup (`Ctrl+C` leaves no partial files)
- [x] SHA-256 verification for Go archives (node / Java / Python checksums still to come)
- [x] Session activation without touching the system environment
- [x] `--json` machine interface
- [x] Prebuilt archives published to GitHub Releases (windows / linux / darwin on
      amd64 / arm64, with checksums)

**Next**

- [ ] Configurable runtime definitions (FR-11). Today runtime definitions are
      compiled-in Go code; `config.json` cannot add or override one yet
- [ ] Checksums for node, Java and Python, and a `doctor` connectivity check
      against every configured download source
- [ ] Remaining runtimes on the same `Spec` definition, including the database
      and middleware kinds (`MySQL`, `Redis`, `Nginx`) that already have a
      reserved `kind` field
- [ ] shell completion scripts; `--dry-run` is rejected until it is implemented (it used to be accepted and silently ignored, BUG-020)
- [ ] Log rotation honoring `logs.keep`

**Not planned**

- Automatic switching on `cd` — it needs a global shell hook, which would break
  the non-invasive promise. Use `ployenv shell` in each project terminal.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © MOMIEDEJIYI

# dsh-balance-usage DeepSeek Harness 插件：在侧边栏**左下角**用**绿色**显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与**当前峰谷时段** （空闲 / 忙碌），点击展开账户余额、峰谷切换倒计时、忙碌时段时间表与近期用量统计； 并在输入框下方与每一轮的用量旁边，按**官方高峰 / 空闲价**估算**每个会话**与**每一轮**的花费。 只依赖 DSH 官方账号服务与本地会话日志，不接入任何第三方服务。
English overview A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that adds cost awareness to the Web UI. It shows the DeepSeek account balance and the current peak / off-peak phase in the sidebar, and estimates per-session and per-turn cost using the official peak and off-peak rates. The balance comes from DSH's own account service and the cost is estimated from local session logs — it talks to no third-party service. - **Sidebar footer (bottom-left)** — the account balance in green when healthy, plus a coloured dot and a label stating whether it is currently **off-peak** or **peak** (peak = twice the off-peak price). Clicking opens a panel with the balance, the current pricing window with a live countdown to the next switch, the peak-hours timetable, and recent usage (today / last 7 days / last N days, a 14-day chart, and a per-model table). - **Composer dock** — an inline `本会话消耗 ≈¥x` pill next to DSH's own session usage line. Clicking expands an anchored panel **upwards** (a `position: fixed` portal, so the row never grows). - **Per-turn actions row** — an inline `本轮花费 ≈¥x` trigger rendered in the same row as DSH's built-in `本轮用量` trigger, using flex `order` to sit to its right. Pricing follows the official rules: peak is **Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing time**; weekends and Chinese public holidays are off-peak all day. Un-cached input, cache reads, cache writes and output are priced separately, using the token fields DSH records per request. Everything is local: the client talks to the host half over one read-only loopback route (`/dsh-balance-usage/summary` and `/dsh-balance-usage/session`). Credentials are never touched by the plugin — the balance comes from DSH's account service, or from a `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` only when the official account is not signed in. `npm test` runs `test/verify.mjs`, a dependency-free offline end-to-end verifier (176 assertions) that drives the real host route handler with fake services and renders the client half through a minimal React compatibility layer. The rest of this document is in Chinese.
--- ## 功能 ### 1. 左下角余额条目（绿色） - 侧边栏展开时：钱包图标 + `余额` + 金额胶囊 + 时段圆点 + 时段文字。 - 侧边栏收起（56px 轨道）时：紧凑显示 `¥12.34`，圆点颜色依旧表示峰谷。 - 金额按余额状态着色： - **充足 → 绿色**（`--dsw-alias-state-success-primary`） - 偏低 → 琥珀色（低于 `lowBalanceThreshold`，默认 10） - 为 0 → 红色 - 时段圆点：**绿色 = 空闲时段**，**琥珀色 = 忙碌时段**。 - 悬停提示会同时给出余额、当前时段与「距切换还有多久」。 ### 2. 点击展开的浮层面板 | 区块 | 内容 | |---|---| | 账户余额 | 总额（大字、按状态着色，**点击直接跳官方账号页**）、充值 / 赠送拆分、余额来源；「官方账号」与「充值」分别打开官方用量页 / 充值页 | | 当前计价时段 | 空闲 / 忙碌胶囊、当前北京时间、**距下一次切换的实时倒计时**与切换时刻 | | 忙碌时段（高峰计价） | 明确列出 **周一至周五 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（北京时间）**，并说明高峰价 = 空闲价 × 2、周末与法定节假日全天按空闲计价 | | 近期用量 | 今日 / 近 7 天 / 近 N 天的 Token、估算费用、请求次数；近 14 天每日 Token 柱状图；按模型拆分表 | - **竖条悬停看详情**：鼠标移到每日柱状图上会弹出明细浮层 —— 日期、合计 Token、输入 / 输出、 缓存命中、请求次数、高峰 / 空闲拆分，以及当天的**花费**。 - Token 一律用 **K / M** 表示（不换算成 B），大小量级之间可以直接比较。 - 面板 **560px 宽**，高度贴合可用窗口（最多占满视口高度减去 32px），内容超出时面板内部滚动。 - 面板通过 `react-dom` 的 portal 渲染到 `document.body`，用 `position: fixed` 贴住左下角条目向上展开， 因此不受侧边栏 `overflow` 与过渡动画的裁剪影响。 - 点击面板外部或按 `Esc` 关闭；点「刷新」、**右键余额条目**、或窗口重新获得焦点都会立即刷新。 - **自动刷新间隔可调**：面板底部有下拉框（关闭 / 15 秒 / 1 分钟 / 2 分钟 / 5 分钟 / 15 分钟）， 改动立即生效并存进 `localStorage`（键名 `dsh-balance-usage.prefs`）。默认值来自 Host 的 `config.refreshSeconds`（出厂 60 秒）。 - **外观可切换**：面板底部的「外观」分三档 —— **默认**（跟随应用主题）/ **深色** / **浅色**， 选择也存进 `dsh-balance-usage.prefs`，两个浮层（左下角面板、底部与每轮的花费浮层）一起生效。 深色 / 浅色不是另画一套配色，而是在浮层根元素上**覆盖官方主题 token** （`--dsw-alias-bg-overlay`、`--dsw-alias-label-*`、`--dsw-alias-border-*` 等）， 浮层里所有既有规则整体跟随，不会出现「不深不浅」的半吊子配色。 - **不会让你白等一个刷新周期**：刚打开 Harness 时 Host 路由可能刚注册、当前会话也可能还没有用量， 这时每 3 秒重试一次直到拿到数据（拿到后交回常规刷新间隔）；页面重新可见或窗口重新获得焦点时 也会立刻刷新。Host 侧也**不再缓存失败结果**，避免客户端在 TTL 内一直拿不到数据。 ### 3. 对话下方：本会话花费 注册进 `conversation.composer.dock`（输入框下方那一栏）： ``` 🎛 本会话消耗 ≈ ¥5.67 ← 胶囊是 inline-flex，和官方那行用量统计并排同一行 ``` 点一下**向上**弹出明细浮层： ``` ┌───────────────────────────────┐ │ 🎛 本会话金额 ≈ ¥5.67 │ │ ───────────────────────────── │ │ 高峰花费 ≈ ¥1.20 │ │ 空闲花费 ≈ ¥4.47 │ │ 请求次数 128 次 │ │ 缓存命中率 99.4% │ │ 模型 deepseek-flash │ │ │ │ 本地按官方价表估算，非官方账单。│ └───────────────────────────────┘ ``` 关键是**展开不会改变那一栏的高度**（早期版本就是在这一点上做错了）： - 胶囊外层 `display:inline-flex`，与官方那行用量统计**并排**，不另起一行； - 展开的浮层是 **portal 到 `document.body` 的 `position: fixed` 元素**，用官方基元 `primitives.useAnchoredPosition({ side: "top", gap: 6, margin: 8 })` 锚在胶囊上沿并**向上**展开 —— 浮层完全脱离文档流，展开 / 收起时那一栏高度一个像素都不变； - 关闭走官方基元 `primitives.useDismissOnOutsidePointer`，另加 `Esc`； - 两个官方基元缺失时都有降级实现（自己按 `bottom` 定位 + 自己监听外部点击），功能不受影响； - 官方界面已经显示 Token 用量，所以这里**只谈钱**：胶囊显示金额，浮层显示花费拆分与请求数， 不再重复 `未缓存输入 / 缓存读取 / 输出` 那些数字； - 没有可统计用量时**整条不渲染**（不留占位、不留空行）。 数据来自 Host 的 `/dsh-balance-usage/session?sessionId=…`（按会话统计整个对话，不按时间窗口截断， 带 15 秒缓存），随自动刷新间隔一起更新。 ### 4. 每一轮：本轮花费 挂在 `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` —— 也就是**官方「本轮用量」所在的那一行**。 DSH 内部把该槽位的内容当作 `extraActions` 传给 `MessageIconActions`，而官方的 「本轮用量」正是同一个组件的 `usageAction`： ```jsx } // 官方「本轮用量 11.14M tok」 /> ``` `extraActions` 在 `usageAction` **之前**渲染，而 `.actions` 是 flex 容器， 所以本插件用 `order: 1` 把自己排到所有默认 `order: 0` 的兄弟之后，落到行尾： ``` … ⧉ ⑂ | 本轮用量 11.14M tok 12:34 | 🎛 本轮花费 ≈¥0.46 ↑ 本插件（order:1 排到最后） ``` - 触发器尺寸对齐官方 `TurnUsagePanel` 的触发器：`inline-flex`、高 `calc(28px + var(--dsh-content-font-delta,0px))`、`border-radius:var(--dsw-radius-sm)`， hover / 展开时用 `--dsw-alias-interactive-bg-hover` —— 和官方那个触发器是同一套控件； - 图标用官方的 **`IconGaugeOutlineRegular`**（仪表盘 = 计量 / 消耗）。 官方「本轮用量」用的是 `IconDatabaseOutlineRegular`，所以花费这边刻意不复用它； - 点击用**和官方完全相同的交互**向上弹出明细浮层（portal 到 body + `position: fixed` + `useAnchoredPosition({ side: "top" })`）：标题「本轮金额」+ 高峰花费 / 空闲花费 / 请求次数 / 模型； - 该槽位只提供 `messageId`，所以 Host 会把每一轮包含哪些 assistant 消息 id 一起返回， 客户端按 `messageId → 轮次 → 花费` 反查； - **没有该轮数据时返回 `null`**（该 slot 的契约明确允许「无内容的条目返回 null」）， 不会留空位、不会多出空白。 ### 5. 空闲 / 忙碌时段的官方口径 依据 DeepSeek 官方定价文档： > Off-peak rates are half of the peak rates. **Peak hours are 01:00 - 04:00 and 06:00 - 10:00 UTC, > Monday through Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays.** All other hours are off-peak, > including weekends and Chinese public holidays in full. > > —— 换算为北京时间（UTC+8）即： | | 时间 | |---|---| | **忙碌（高峰计价）** | 周一至周五 **09:00–12:00**、**14:00–18:00** | | **空闲（低谷计价）** | 工作日其余时间、**周六周日全天**、**中国法定节假日全天** | 内置了 `2026` 年法定节假日表（依据[国务院办公厅 2025-11-04 通知](https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/content/202511/content_7047090.htm)）， 可用 `holidays` 配置项整体覆盖。 峰谷归属按**请求发起时刻**（`step/start` 事件时间）判定，取不到时回退到消息完成时刻。 官方未公开跨时段请求按发起还是按完成计费，这是合理近似；实测请求耗时在秒级，边界影响极小。 ### 6. 价格表（空闲时段价，元 / 百万 tokens） | 模型 | 输入（缓存未命中） | 输入（缓存命中） | 输出 | |---|---|---|---| | `deepseek-flash` | 1 | 0.02 | 4 | | `deepseek-v4-pro` | 4.5 | 0.15 | 13.5 | | `deepseek-chat`（旧） | 2 | 0.5 | 3 | | `deepseek-reasoner`（旧） | 4 | 1 | 16 | 高峰时段按 ×2 计。模型名做了归一化：含 `pro` → v4-pro，含 `flash` → flash， 因此 `deepseek-flash` 与旧名 `deepseek-v4-flash` 走同一套价。 > **计费口径**：DSH 的 `TokenUsage.inputTokens` 是**未缓存输入**，不含缓存命中的部分 —— > 实测 `inputTokens + cacheReadTokens + cacheWriteTokens + outputTokens === totalTokens`， > 正好和官方价表的「INPUT (CACHE MISS)」/「INPUT (CACHE HIT)」两栏一一对应。 > 所以未缓存输入按 input 价、缓存读取按 cacheRead 价分别计价（早期版本曾把缓存读取从输入里 > 再减一次，导致未缓存输入被算成 0、费用偏低，已修正）。 --- ## 安装 本插件是一个标准的 DSH bundle 包（`package.json` 里带 `dsh.bundle.patch` 与 `dsh.client`）， 安装后由 profile 的 bundle 栈自动挂载，无需手改 `cordis.patch.yml`。 ### 已验证的安装方式（本地 link） ```powershell cd $env:DSH_PROFILE_DIR # 通常是 C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\profiles\desktop pnpm add "link:C:\Users\<你>\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\dsh-balance-usage" ``` 然后把 `dsh-balance-usage` 加进该 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组： ```json { "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles":

plugins.readme_text:
# @tryao/dsh-wps365-plugin

给你的 DSH 装上 **WPS 365 云文档**能力。

本仓库同时支持 DSH 插件和 Codex 本地插件适配，二者版本同步；安装方式分别说明。Codex 版本的源码与构建说明见 [`codex/`](codex/README.md)。

装好之后不用再手动导出、复制粘贴：你可以直接让 agent 读一篇 WPS 智能文档、把内容写进云文档、改云端表格里的某个单元格，它都能真的去读写你的 WPS 365 文档 —— 包括别人通过分享链接给你的文档。

> ⚠️ **本插件仅适用于 WPS 365 企业版账号，个人版账号请勿使用。**
>
> 它调用的是 WPS 365 企业版提供的云文档接口，`wps365-cli` 也必须用企业版账号完成授权。WPS 个人版账号没有这些能力，装上也读写不了任何文档；个人版用户请不要安装，也不要尝试用它处理本地文件。

> 插件本体只提供技能（`wps365-docs`）与配套脚本，**不含**任何 WPS 账号信息；所有云文档操作都由你自己安装的 `wps365-cli` 完成。

---

## 它能帮你做什么

| 你可以这样说 | 它会做什么 |
|---|---|
| "把这篇 WPS 文档总结一下" / "这篇智能文档里有哪些待办" | 读智能文档（`.otl`）：还原成 Markdown（标题、列表、**表格**、引用、加粗、代码块），长文自动分页读，不把全文塞进上下文 |
| "文档里的那张架构图给我看看" | 下载文档里**所有**内嵌图片到本地（含表格单元格里的图、processon 图），只按需把你要看的那几张读进上下文 |
| "把这份 Markdown 写进这篇智能文档" | 写入智能文档：整篇替换 / 追加到末尾 / 插到最前；写入前可先预演块结构 |
| "把文档里第二段改掉" | 逐段原地编辑智能文档（块级 API），不用整篇重写 |
| "读一下这个 .docx / .xlsx / .pptx" | 下载原件到本地，并抽出正文 Markdown、表格、**公式原文**、每个工作表一份 CSV |
| "把附件里的这个表格改一下再传回去" | 本地编辑后整文件传回：`file_id` 与分享链接不变，版本历史保留、可回滚；也能新建文件 |
| "把云端表格里 B2 改成 99，D2 加上公式" | 云端 `.xlsx` 一条龙：下载 → 改 → 重算公式缓存值 → 传回，一条命令完成 |
| "这是别人分享给我的链接，帮我读一下" | 从 kdocs / plus 分享链接解析出文档并正常读取（无需"接收文件"这类前置动作） |
| "帮我把这份文档改一下" | **写入前先比对云端是否已被他人修改**；发现冲突就停下、告诉你冲突在哪，绝不静默覆盖 |

它内置了这套流程里踩过的坑（17 条智能文档硬约束、普通文件接口细节、并发写入的实测语义），所以遇到"表格整块消失""公式变成空值""代码块语言被降级""写完下载还是旧内容"这类问题，它知道该怎么绕。

## 需要先准备什么

1. **WPS 365 企业版账号（必须）**
   本插件只适用于 WPS 365 企业版账号；**WPS 个人版账号不受支持，请勿安装和使用**。`wps365-cli` 需要先用企业版账号授权，本文提到的智能文档、云文档读写与分享链接解析能力才会生效。

2. **`wps365-cli`（运行本插件的必要条件；本插件不安装它，只使用它）**
   所有云文档操作都由这个官方 CLI 完成；没装它，插件读写不了任何文档。[`wps365-open/cli`](https://github.com/wps365-open/cli) 是它的源码与文档仓库，用官方安装脚本安装：

   **macOS / Linux**

   ```bash
   curl -fsSL https://open-docs.wpscdn.cn/cli/install.sh | bash
   ```

   **Windows（PowerShell）**

   ```powershell
   irm https://open-docs.wpscdn.cn/cli/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

   **Windows（Git Bash）**

   ```bash
   curl -fsSL https://open-docs.wpscdn.cn/cli/install.sh | bash
   ```

   macOS / Linux 默认装到 `~/.local/bin`（无需 sudo），Windows 上是 `~\.local\bin\wps365-cli.exe`。要指定版本或安装目录，在管道末尾的 `bash` 前加环境变量：`... | WPS365_VERSION=v0.3.6 bash`、`... | WPS365_INSTALL_DIR=~/.local/bin bash`；不想用脚本就去 [Release 页面](https://github.com/wps365-open/cli/releases) 下载对应平台的二进制文件。

   装好后完成应用绑定与授权（只需一次）：

   ```bash
   wps365-cli config init        # 新建/绑定应用，在浏览器里完成
   wps365-cli auth login --device
   wps365-cli user me            # 确认当前登录身份
   ```

   `config init` 会打开浏览器完成应用创建/绑定与授权确认；企业管理员建议预先设置 CLI 应用免审规则，手动创建应用、配置回调地址与申请权限的完整流程见官方[前置准备：创建应用与权限配置](https://github.com/wps365-open/cli/blob/main/docs/prerequisites.md)。装在别处就在配置里指定 `cli`（见下；支持 `~` 与 `%NAME%`/`${NAME}` 展开，也可以直接写裸命令名让它在 `PATH` 里找）。**CLI 缺失或未授权不会让插件失效**：技能照常可用，只是会在技能正文里明确告诉你 CLI 没找到。

3. **Python（带 openpyxl）**
   读 `.xlsx` 的公式、以及云端改表格需要 openpyxl。默认让 agent 用 `load_workspace_dependencies` 返回的解释器（该环境自带 openpyxl / python-docx）；想固定一个就在配置里指定 `python`。

4. **会话里有 shell 工具**
   脚本由模型通过 shell 执行（macOS / Linux 是 `bash`，Windows 是 PowerShell 或 `cmd`）；另外还需要文件读取工具分页读导出的 `doc.md`、`read_image` 看图片。

5. **平台差异（Windows）**
   技能正文里的命令一律是单行、占位符由插件注入真实值，所以两个平台都能直接照抄；注入的「本机资源」一节会告诉你本机平台、Python 解释器、`wps365-cli` 路径与临时目录。Windows 上另需注意：路径含空格时用双引号包住。

6. **删掉手动安装的同名技能（重要）**
   如果你之前把这份技能手动放在 `~/.dsh/skills/wps365-docs`，同名技能里**它优先级更高**（用户目录里的技能盖住插件自带的），插件的版本就不会被用上。想让插件版本生效：
   ```
   rm -rf ~/.dsh/skills/wps365-docs
   ```
   技能目录是被 watch 的，删完不用重启。

## 安装

**从 npm 装（推荐）** —— 已发布到 npm，按包名安装即可：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @tryao/dsh-wps365-plugin
```

也可以在 DSH 的插件管理器界面里搜索 `@tryao/dsh-wps365-plugin` 安装。

**从本地目录装**（改插件时用，软链到仓库，改完即时生效；这里的路径是**仓库目录**，与 npm 包名无关）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /绝对路径/dsh-wps365-plugin
```

或让 agent 调用：

```
plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "@tryao/dsh-wps365-plugin" }
```

装好后新开一个会话，问一句"读一下这篇 WPS 文档 `<file_id>`"。确认生效的方法：加载进来的技能正文**末尾**会附带一段「本机资源（由 @tryao/dsh-wps365-plugin 注入）」，里面给出脚本目录、`wps365-cli` 路径和该用哪个 Python。

卸载：

```
plugin_manager { action: "remove_bundle", target: "@tryao/dsh-wps365-plugin" }
```

> ⚠️ DSH 插件请使用 **0.1.1 或更高版本**。DSH 的 0.1.0 有一个会让 Harness 打不开的严重问题，它从未发布到 npm；详见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

## 在 Codex 中使用

Codex 版本由 `codex/` 中的源码构建，和上面的 DSH 插件分别安装。Codex 版本同样**仅适用于 WPS 365 企业版账号**，个人版账号请勿使用。克隆仓库后，在仓库根目录构建并运行打包检查：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/YiuTerran/dsh-wps365-plugin.git
cd dsh-wps365-plugin
npm --prefix codex run build
npm --prefix codex test
```

构建需要 Node.js 22 或更高版本；生成 `.tar.gz` 归档还需要系统提供 `tar` 命令。无需运行 `npm install`，构建和检查使用 Node.js 内置模块。构建会生成完整插件目录 `codex/dist/wps365-docs/` 和归档 `codex/dist/wps365-docs-0.1.2.tar.gz`。请把**构建生成的目录**注册并安装；`codex/wps365-docs/` 是源码，不含构建复制进去的共享 Python 脚本，不能直接作为完整插件安装。

在 Codex 中可以这样请求安装：

> 将当前仓库构建得到的 `codex/dist/wps365-docs` 注册到我的个人本地插件市场，并帮我安装。保留已有市场配置。

Codex 的本地插件市场由本机配置发现，市场清单中的插件路径相对于市场根目录。安装到个人本地市场只对当前用户和设备生效，不会发布给其他用户；每位使用者都要安装并授权自己的 `wps365-cli`（安装与授权步骤见上文「需要先准备什么」第 2 条）：

```bash
wps365-cli config init
wps365-cli auth login --device
```

可参考 [Codex 官方插件构建说明](https://developers.openai.com/plugins/build/plugins)。如果安装后插件没有显示，重启 Codex 桌面应用；插件可用后新开一个聊天，再提出文档任务，例如：

> 读取这篇 WPS 文档并概括重点：<分享链接或 file_id>

Codex 使用本地执行环境运行 Python 脚本和 `wps365-cli`。处理 `.xlsx` 需要 `openpyxl`，用 `python-docx` 创建或处理 DOCX 需要 `python-docx`；有 Codex 提供的 `load_workspace_dependencies` 时可使用其中的 Python，否则本机需有相应 Python 依赖。Excel 编辑和公式重算使用当前可用的 Office 技能能力；Codex 版本不依赖 DSH 附带的 LibreOffice Kit。

## 配置（可选）

插件行的 id 是 `skill-wps365-docs`，三个字段都有默认值，**不配也能用**：

| 字段 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `cli` | `~/.local/bin/wps365-cli` | `wps365-cli` 的位置；设成 `false` 表示不注入 CLI 路径 |
| `python` | 未设置 | 指定跑脚本的解释器（需带 openpyxl / python-docx）；不设则用 `load_workspace_dependencies` 的 |
| `assetRoot` | 插件自带资源目录 | 绝对路径，仅当技能资源被搬到别处时需要 |

在 profile 自己的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖（patch 是整体替换 `config`，要写全）：

```yaml
- id: skill-wps365-docs
  name: './index.js'
  config:
    cli: /opt/wps365/bin/wps365-cli
    python: /opt/python/bin/python3
```

字段名写错会在激活时直接报错，不会静默忽略。

> ⚠️ 这个配置是手写的（为了让包保持零依赖），不是 DSH 原生的 schemastery 图，所以 DSH 的配置检查与设置界面**不会**为这一行渲染配置表单（`cordis_inspect_query` 里该行状态显示 `unsupported`）。这不影响插件工作 —— 行照常挂载、技能照常加载、字段校验照常生效，只是改配置要按上面的 YAML 手写。默认值在你的机器上就是对的，通常不用改。

## 使用时的注意事项

- **云文档没有本地撤销**：插件会按技能要求先导出备份，但重要文档建议你自己也留一份。
- **写入超时不等于写入失败**：智能文档的写入接口可能已在服务端提交只是响应没回来，所以它重试前会先查块数，避免写两遍。
- **写入前一定要看冲突结论**：它报冲突时，正确做法是重新拉最新版本、合并你的改动后再写；确实要覆盖才会用强制参数。
- **规模上限**：智能文档单次写入 1000 块（脚本自动分批）；代码块语言只有接口枚举内的才保留（写 `powershell` 会被静默降级成纯文本，它知道这件事）。
- **普通文件走"下载 → 本地改 → 传回"**：`.docx` / `.xlsx` / `.pptx` 没有可用的逐段写接口，公式、格式、合并、多工作表全靠整文件传回保住。云端 `.xlsx` 的接口写入是异步落盘的，写完不要立刻下载校验。
- **权限边界**：它用你本机 `wps365-cli` 的身份和权限操作云文档，能读写的就是那个账号能读写的东西；插件自己不保存、也不接触凭据。
- **账号边界**：只支持 WPS 365 企业版账号；WPS 个人版账号请勿使用，接口不可用，插件无法工作。
- **上下文开销**：技能正文保持精简，细节（17 条硬约束、接口细节、并发实测语义）放在三份按需读取的参考文档里，只有真需要时才读。
- **升级**：换版本需要重启 Harness 才会加载新的 JS；只改技能文档（`assets/**`）的话，下次加载技能即生效。
- 本插件**不注册**任何新工具、也不改动你 profile 里的 MCP 配置；`mcp__wps365__*`（如果你配了 WPS 的 MCP）与它是两套独立能力。

## 验证安装

离线自查（不需要 Harness、不需要联网、不会碰你的云文档）：

```bash
node --test                        # Node 侧用例：技能解析/资源预算、bundle 与补丁结构、apply() 契约、配置校验、CLI 定位
python3 test/scripts_test.py       # Python 侧用例：CLI 定位、管道解码、LibreOffice kit 探测（纯标准库）
node --check index.js
python3 -m py_compile assets/wps365-docs/scripts/*.py
```

`npm test` 会依次跑前两条；CI 在 Linux 上跑（Windows 语义由注入的假环境覆盖，不依赖真机）。

真实验证：让 agent 读一篇你确定有权限的文档，问它"这篇文档的标题是什么、有几个表格"，确认拿到的是真实内容；再让它用 `--dry-run` 写一次（只做转换、不写入、不产生文件），看块结构与比对输出是否符合预期，然后才动真文档。

## 仓库结构（想改插件的人看）

```
index.js                      # Host 插件：向 ctx.skills 注册 wps365-docs
src/plugin-config.js          # 配置校验（手写 Standard Schema v1，零依赖）
src/skill-catalog.js          # 纯函数：解析技能 frontmatter、构造 catalog entry、渲染本机资源块
src/cli-locate.js             # 纯函数：跨平台定位 wps365-cli（PATHEXT、PATH、~ / %VAR% 展开）
cordis.patch.yml              # bundle patch：插入 skill-wps365-docs 行
assets/wps365-docs/
├── SKILL.md                  # 常驻正文（约 3.4k 字符，控制在 8192 的修剪阈值内）
├── references/               # otl.md / office-files.md / concurrency.md，按需读取
└── scripts/                  # otl_fetch.py otl_write.py file_fetch.py file_write.py xlsx_edit.py
                              # _wps_cli.py：五个脚本共用的 CLI 定位 + UTF-8 管道封装
locale/{en,zh}.json  icon.svg  test/   # test/scripts_test.py 是 Python 侧用例，npm test 会跑
scripts/check-package.mjs     # 校验 npm 打包内容（CI 也会跑）
scripts/cle

plugins.description: Per-model reasoning effort levels inside DeepSeek Harness Settings -> Models, written to that model's reasoningEfforts in cordis.patch.yml.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-reasoning-levels

Per-model reasoning effort levels inside DeepSeek Harness's **Settings → Models**.
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/releases/tag/v0.1.2)
[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/commits/main)
[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/stargazers)
[![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/pulls)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.17-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js)](https://nodejs.org)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.0--rc.2-4B5563?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

**Model Reasoning Levels** — the reasoning-effort control each model entry is
missing, written straight into that model's `reasoningEfforts` in the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`.

The shipped Models page edits a model's `id`, display name, context window,
max-output tokens and input types, and deliberately edits **no** reasoning
effort: effort is a per-*model* capability while that editor is per-*provider*.
This plugin adds the missing control **inside each model entry** — directly
under the id/name line, or under the expanded context-window/input-types area —
and converts the selection into the model's `reasoningEfforts` in the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`.

## What it contributes

| Surface | What it does |
|---|---|
| `settings.models.provider-card` (keyed `llm-pi-ai`) | reaches each pi-ai provider card, discovers its model rows, and portals a per-model effort editor into every model entry — hand-declared routes included |
| Locale namespace `dsh-model-reasoning-levels` | English and Simplified Chinese copy |
| `scripts/reasoning-efforts.mjs` | validates a selection and prints the `reasoningEfforts` YAML and the settings path op it becomes |

Browser half only: the host half (`exports["."]`) exists so the Loader row can
carry the browser half (`exports["./client"]`). No route, no service, no Config.

## What it looks like

```
Settings → Models → Baidu Team → Customized settings → Models
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ [deepseek-v4.1-flash] [DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash]       ⌄   🗑   │
│ Reasoning effort levels              Inherited              │
│ [Off] [Minimal] [Low] [Medium] [High] [XHigh] [Max]        │
│ Low wire value: low   High wire value: high                 │
│ [Inherit catalog] [Non-reasoning] [Apply]  { off: null, … } │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

![The Reasoning effort levels control appended inside a model entry on the Settings → Models page](docs/images/reasoning-levels-row.png)

*The control inside one model entry: the seven level chips, one wire-value field
per selected thinking level, **Inherit catalog** / **Non-reasoning** / **Apply**,
and the exact `reasoningEfforts` value the current selection becomes.*

## How the control reaches the row

The shipped page declares **no seat inside a model row**, and its `ModelRow` is
an internal component. The only sanctioned row-level change is shadowing the
whole `settings.section` `models` entry — a shadowed copy of the page. This plugin takes
the narrower path instead: it owns the provider-card seat, then discovers each
model row structurally.

- The row's id input carries an `aria-label` built from the shipped page's own
  `settings.models` locale namespace (`Model ID 1`, `模型 ID 1`, …). The plugin
  binds that namespace and matches the label, so discovery follows the active
  language and never depends on a hashed CSS class name.
- It appends one container per `modelEntry` and portals a React editor into it,
  so the control lives inside the model entry and disappears with the row.
- A `MutationObserver` re-runs discovery when the fold opens, a row is added or
  removed, or the page re-renders. A shipped row restructure would need the
  selector updated.

### Saving, and the page's own Apply

The editor writes through the settings transport (`settings.mutate` path ops);
the host persists the result. The shipped page keeps its **own draft** of the
model list and its own Apply writes the whole `models` array for a hand-declared
route, which can restore the `reasoningEfforts` value the card loaded at open.

To keep the editor's value authoritative, the row remembers the declaration the
user applied and, if a later settings change reverts it, writes it again — up to
three times, so a refusal is reported instead of retried forever. Applying the
effort and then using the card's Apply for another field therefore converges on
the effort value you chose.

For a catalog route the editor uses the narrow
`providers.<route>.modelOverrides.<id>.reasoningEfforts` path, which the page's
model editor does not touch — unless the page materializes a `models` array (by
editing the model list), which the adapter refuses beside `modelOverrides`. The
row's re-apply covers that case while the card is open.

## The level vocabulary is closed and ordered

`off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max` — exactly the harness's own
`THINKING_LEVELS`, in escalation order. The editor always emits the map in that
order, whatever order the chips were clicked. `off` means "do not think"; the
other six are thinking levels.

## The conversion rules (they are the adapter's)

Each chosen level becomes a key whose value is the spelling dispatch sends, so a
gateway with its own vocabulary can be renamed (`max: ultra`). The plugin
enforces `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`'s `resolveModelReasoning` rules before the
write:

| Selection | Result |
|---|---|
| `off, low, high, max` with wire values | `{ off: null, low: 'low', high: 'high', max: 'max' }` |
| `off` alone | refused — a model that cannot think uses `false` |
| nothing selected | refused — omit the field to inherit |
| a non-`off` level with no wire value | refused — it needs the value dispatch sends |
| an empty-string wire value | refused |
| a level outside the seven | refused |
| the "Non-reasoning" form | `reasoningEfforts: false` |
| the "Inherit catalog" form | the field is unset, restoring inheritance |

A declared map **replaces** the model's capability set: levels not declared are
not offered. That is why `off` must be present in the map when the user keeps
it, and why "off only" is `false` rather than `{ off: null }`.

## Where the value lands in `cordis.patch.yml`

The editor writes settings path ops; the host persists them into the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`. `reasoningEfforts` sits beside the fields the shipped row
already edits:

```yaml
- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"
  config:
    providers:
      baidu-team:
        models:
          - id: deepseek-v4.1-flash
            reasoningEfforts: { off: null, low: 'low', high: 'high', max: 'max' }
            contextWindow: 1000000
            maxTokens: 256000
            input: [text, image]
            name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
```

The expanded spelling is equivalent and easier to hand-edit:

```yaml
            reasoningEfforts:
              off:
              low: 'low'
              high: 'high'
              max: 'max'
```

A model that cannot think, and one that keeps the installed catalog capability:

```yaml
          - id: acme-plain
            reasoningEfforts: false      # no selector beyond off
          - id: acme-catalog
            contextWindow: 128000        # reasoningEfforts omitted -> inherits
```

plugins.description: Chess Game Plugin for Deepseek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Chess Game

国际象棋 × 两种形态：**单文件网页版**（双人同屏）+ **DeepSeek Harness Web 插件**（悬浮窗，双人/人机对战，PGN 导出）。零依赖、完全离线。

## 网页版（index.html）

两个人在同一台电脑上用鼠标轮流对战，浏览器打开 `index.html` 即玩。

- 白方先行，点一下自己的棋子（显示可走格圆点），再点一下目标格落子
- 红圈表示可吃子；被将军的王红圈高亮提示

## DSH 插件 dsh-chess-float（packages/chess-float/）

在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面里下棋：输入框工具栏 **♟ 按钮** → 弹出**可拖动悬浮窗**。

**功能**：

- 双人对战 / 人机对战（可选执白或执黑）
- 人机 AI：本地 negamax + αβ 剪枝引擎，5 级难度（入门→大师，难度=搜索深度，低难度带随机失误），毫秒级响应、零模型调用、完全离线
- 完整规则：王车易位、吃过路兵、兵升变、将杀、逼和、50 回合规则、子力不足和棋
- 悔棋（人机模式自动回退双方各一步）、SAN 标准记谱、**PGN 棋谱导出**（可导入 Lichess / chess.com 复盘）
- 主题 token 适配明暗主题

**安装**：

```bash
# 从源码（本仓库）
dsh plugin add packages/chess-float

# 离线安装（其他机器）
mkdir -p ~/plugins/chess-float
tar -xzf dsh-chess-float-1.2.0.tgz -C ~/plugins/chess-float --strip-components=1
dsh plugin add ~/plugins/chess-float
```

预构建 tarball 见 [Releases](https://github.com/x-cores/dsh-chess-game/releases)。安装后刷新 Web 页面即可看到 ♟ 按钮。

## 正确性验证

走法引擎通过标准 perft 校验（走法枚举数与国际象棋公认参考值完全一致）：

| 测试局面 | 深度 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 初始局面 | 1–4 层 | 20 / 400 / 8,902 / 197,281 ✓ |
| CPW #3（吃过路兵密集） | 1–5 层 | 14 / 191 / 2,812 / 43,238 / 674,624 ✓ |
| CPW #4（易位/升变密集） | 1–4 层 | 6 / 264 / 9,467 / 422,333 ✓ |

AI 引擎验证：深度 3 对随机对手 71 步将杀（约 44ms/步）；大师(5) 单步约 1.2s。

## 运行测试

```bash
node test-perft.js      # perft 规则校验
node test-gameplay.js   # 完整对局路径模拟（易位/过路兵/升变/SAN）
```

plugins.description: Automatic guitar-tab transcriber & synced player generator as an Agent Skill — works with DeepSeek Harness (dsh), Claude Code and compatible harnesses
plugins.readme_text:
# Guitar Tab Maker · 吉他谱工坊

自动扒歌 + 生成「边播放边跳和弦」的吉他跟练播放器。技能目录形式，遵循 [Agent Skills](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/agents-and-tools/agent-skills) 规范（`SKILL.md` + `scripts/`），**可直接被 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）、Claude Code 等兼容 harness 加载**。

## 它做什么

输入一首歌的音频（mp3/wav/m4a/flac），输出单文件 HTML 播放器：

- 原曲音频内嵌（**不转调、不损伤音质**）
- 和弦随播放进度跳动高亮，附下一个和弦预告
- 每个和弦带指法图（开放和弦 + 大横按）
- 每小节标注扫弦箭头（8 个八分音符格）
- 歌词逐行同步、段落快捷跳转、播放变速跟练

## 工作管线

| 脚本 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `scripts/fetch_lrc.py` | 双通道抓带时间轴歌词（酷我 musicId 优先，网易云兜底） |
| `scripts/analyze_song.py` | librosa 扒谱：beat 追踪 + 调内白名单 HMM/Viterbi + 小节制合并 |
| `scripts/verify_song.py` | 音频-谱面一致性校验（低频频谱根音比对），防原调标错/文件错配 |
| `scripts/build_songs.py` | 按配置重建曲库；指法和弦按 `(原调根音 − capo) mod 12` 自动换算 |
| `scripts/build_player.py` | 音频 base64 注入模板，生成单文件 HTML |
| `scripts/validate_player.py` | 成品综合校验（占位符/字段/段落索引/图库覆盖） |

## 快速开始

依赖：Python 3.10+、[ffmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/)、Node.js（仅 harness 加载需要）。

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt

# 1) 歌词
python scripts/fetch_lrc.py --title 歌名 --artist 歌手 --kuwo-id 358603096 --out lrc.json
# 2) 扒谱（原调根音与 BPM 为粗略先验，可用网络资料）
python scripts/analyze_song.py --audio song.mp3 --key-root Bb --key-mode minor --bpm 89 --lrc lrc.json --out analysis.json
# 3) 一致性校验（必跑）
python scripts/verify_song.py --audio song.mp3 --analysis analysis.json
# 4) 写配置（参考 examples/songs.example.json）后构建
python scripts/build_songs.py --config songs.json --template assets/player_template.html --out built.html
python scripts/build_player.py --template built.html --out player.html --audio 1=song.mp3
# 5) 终验
python scripts/validate_player.py player.html
```

完整 SOP、变调夹选法与踩坑检查点见 [`SKILL.md`](SKILL.md)。

## 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用

把整个目录放到 dsh 的技能发现路径即可，无需转换：

- 用户级：`~/.dsh/skills/guitar-tab-maker/`（或 `~/.agents/skills/`，Claude Code 同根）
- 项目级：`<repo>/.agents/skills/guitar-tab-maker/`

dsh 只发现发现根下的**直接**子目录（不递归），不要嵌套两层。frontmatter 支持 `disable-model-invocation`、`user-invocable` 两个 dsh 专属开关。

## 免责声明

- 输出为**参考级谱面**：AI 听辨的切换点可能有小偏差，可在 `SONGS` 数据中改 `t` 值自行校准。
- 本仓库**不含任何歌曲音频或歌词**；请仅对自己有权使用的内容扒谱，并自行处理版权。
- MIT License。

plugins.description: Live CPU, memory and GPU readout in the DeepSeek Harness composer status bar.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-dock-vitals

Live **CPU / memory / GPU** readout in the DeepSeek Harness composer status bar — a small clickable badge next to the built-in context meter.

```
2 turns 30 steps · 98 tok/s │ 1.8M tok · cache 84% │ 6%
CPU 13%  MEM 87%  GPU 15%
                ↑ this plugin's badge, right of the context meter
```

- **Display-only plugin.** It registers no tools for the model. Samples never enter the conversation context and are never sent anywhere.
- Three metrics out of the box — **CPU / memory / GPU**; video memory and GPU temperature are one toggle away in settings.
- GPU works across vendors, no admin rights: `nvidia-smi`, `rocm-smi`, macOS `ioreg`, and Windows PDH counters as the catch-all. Whichever backend answers is named in the snapshot, and a backend that cannot report a field leaves it blank instead of printing `0`.
- Click the badge for a details panel: per-metric values, GPU model, core count and capacity.
- Three refresh presets: **fast 1.5 s / medium 3 s / slow 10 s** (default `3000 ms`).
- Opening ten sessions still samples once — every badge shares one snapshot and one timer.
- Sampling stops on its own 15 seconds after the last reader.
- Follows the host language (Chinese / English), including the details panel and tooltips.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-dock-vitals
```

Or drop the tarball in:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-dock-vitals-0.1.0.tgz
```

Restart DSH afterwards.

## Data sources

| Metric | Source | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CPU | Node `os.cpus()` sampled twice | Machine-wide busy percentage (`1 - Δidle/Δtotal`), not per-core. The first sample has no baseline and reads empty. |
| Memory | `os.totalmem()` / `os.freemem()` | |
| GPU | A vendor CLI, probed per platform (see below) | When nothing answers, GPU shows `—` while CPU and memory keep working. |

GPU backends, tried in this order on each platform — the first that answers wins, and the winner is remembered so later ticks skip the dead ones:

| Platform | Backend | Command | Permission | Video memory / temperature |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Windows / Linux, NVIDIA | `nvidia-smi` | `--query-gpu=... --format=csv,noheader,nounits` | none | both |
| Windows, any vendor | PDH counters via `typeperf` | `"\GPU Engine(*)\Utilization Percentage" -sc 2 -si 1` | none | **neither** |
| Linux, AMD | `rocm-smi` | `-u --showmemuse --showmeminfo vram -t --showtemp --showproductname --csv` | none | both |
| macOS, any GPU | `ioreg` (IOKit registry) | `-r -d 1 -w 0 -c IOAccelerator` | **none** | used only (no total) |

`typeperf` is the only way to read a GPU on Windows for AMD/Intel — ROCm is Linux-only — so it is worth knowing its cost: **one round takes ~2.7 s**, where `nvidia-smi` takes ~50 ms. That is why GPU sampling is decoupled from the badge refresh rate: CPU and memory keep their own cadence, and the GPU value is served from the last completed reading.

Aggregation follows Task Manager: sum each process per engine type, then take the **busiest engine type** per adapter, then the busiest adapter. Summing every instance together over-reports, and reading only the 3D engine misses video encode/decode load entirely.

A field the active backend cannot report is `null` in the snapshot, never `0` — a missing temperature and a 0 °C temperature are different things. The details panel hides those rows rather than printing a made-up number.

The host side exposes one read-only endpoint:

```
GET /dsh-dock-vitals/snapshot
```

```json
{
  "cpu": { "percent": 13.2, "cores": 24 },
  "memory": { "usedPercent": 87.3, "usedGiB": 13.7, "totalGiB": 15.7 },
  "gpu": {
    "available": true,
    "name": "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU",
    "utilPercent": 15,
    "memoryUsedMiB": 1816,
    "memoryTotalMiB": 8188,
    "temperatureC": 64,
    "clockMegahertz": 2370
  },
  "gpuError": null,
  "gpuBackend": "nvidia-smi",
  "host": { "platform": "win32", "release": "10.0.26300" },
  "intervalMs": 3000,
  "updatedAt": 0
}
```

`gpuBackend` names the backend that produced the reading, so "why is my GPU blank / missing a temperature" is answerable from the payload itself. Non-loopback callers get `403`; anything but `GET`/`HEAD` gets `405`.

## Settings

Settings → **System Status**:

| Option | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Enable badge | on | Off means the badge never renders and never fetches |
| CPU | on | |
| Memory | on | |
| GPU | on | |
| Video memory | off | Unavailable while GPU is off |
| GPU temperature | off | Same |
| Refresh interval | 3000 ms | 1500 – 60000 ms |

Every field is `volatile`, so changes apply immediately without a restart. Configuration lives in the settings namespace `dock-vitals` — the `id` of the plugin's entry in your profile.

## Compatibility

- dsh `>=0.2.0-rc.1` (developed and verified on `0.2.0-rc.2`).
- Node `>=22`.
- Windows / macOS / Linux. CPU and memory come from Node's `os`; the GPU backends are read-only CLIs and registry reads (`nvidia-smi`, `typeperf`, `rocm-smi`, `ioreg`). Nothing needs administrator rights — this deliberately avoids `powermetrics`, which is macOS's richest GPU source but requires `sudo` on every call.
- Works in both the desktop app and the browser GUI: `dsh.client.platform` is `web`, and the desktop app is a shell around the same web frontend.

## Development notes

- Client components may only `require` modules from the host whitelist (`react`, `react/jsx-runtime`, `react-dom`, `react-dom/client`, `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-dockkit`). Anything else fails to resolve, and a throwing `require` kills the factory → the entry fails → the desktop build refuses to open. **Wrap every `require` in `try/catch` and ship a fallback.**
- Never call a hook inside `apply()`. `useSyncExternalStore`'s `getSnapshot` must return a **stable reference** — an object rebuilt on every call causes an infinite re-render loop.
- Styles use `--dsw-*` theme tokens only; literal colours are reserved for graphics.
- UI is contributed through `ctx.slots.inject(ownerKey, () => ctx.slots.register(...))`.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Deterministic pre-execution tool-call guard plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) - monotonic guard seam, operator-declared policy, decision ledger. Gate: 12/12 green, 2000 benign FP=0, injected 7/7 caught.
plugins.readme_text:
# @phm-audit/dsh-action-guard

A deterministic pre-execution tool-call guard plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`), registered through the official **monotonic guard seam** (`ctx.tools.guard`).

> DeepSeek Harness follows an "everything is a plugin" architecture. This plugin fills one concrete slot: a rules-based, operator-declared guard whose verdicts are reproducible and whose decisions are recorded.

Gate test artifact: 2009-frame deterministic command stream (2000 benign + 7 injected violations + determinism/ledger/pathological-input checks, no RNG, no network) — **0 false positives on benign, all injected violations caught by the intended rule**, 12/12 vitest cases green (2026-10-13). Run: `bash run_demo.sh`.

End-to-end smoke: the Cordis wrapper is additionally verified against the **published npm packages** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 0.0.1-rc.1 (2026-10-13) — loaded the cordis way (`ctx.plugin`, `static inject` resolved), a real tool registered, and a real `execute()` call to a non-allowlisted tool **denied with the expected R-unknown reason through the actual pipeline** (3/3 smoke cases). Version-pinned smoke: the harness is under active development; re-run `npx vitest run tests/smoke.harness.spec.ts` against your deployed version.

## What it checks (all operator-declared, all deterministic)

- **R-unknown** — tool must be in the declared allowlist
- **R-keys** — forbidden parameter keys per tool
- **R-equals** — denied parameter values per tool
- **R-bounds** — numeric parameter bounds per tool (inclusive)
- **Fail-closed** — an internal evaluation error denies with a distinctive reason (a broken guard can never silently become a hole)
- **Decision ledger** — every verdict appended to a local JSONL ledger with a chain id (correlation artifact for incident forensics; FNV-based chain id, not a tamper-proofing guarantee)

## Method lineage — PHM

This plugin is the harness-native expression of the **PHM deterministic-verification methodology** (gate-first, evidence-first), whose parent project [agent-action-verifier](https://github.com/PHM-Audit/agent-action-verifier) is validated on the **AgentDojo official benchmark with a real LLM in the loop** (no ASR/FP events in the v2.2 re-run, FP fix-cycle 16 → 1 → 0 published, all artifacts open with SHA-256 chains, third-party thread engagement on record).

What that lineage means concretely, versus the (crowded, 155-plugin) Security & Permissions category:

1. **Official third-party benchmark lineage** — the parent method is measured on AgentDojo, not only on self-built samples (verified 2026-10-13 across a 10-repo sample of direct competitors: none cites an industry-standard benchmark; the closest, dsh-defend, uses a self-built 105-sample red-team set).
2. **Cross-domain deployment record** — the same gate criteria (benign FP=0 / injected FN=0 / deterministic repeats / fail-closed / audit ledger) run in robot (Unitree official-URDF gate), traffic-flow (845k-frame NGSIM), and SDK-contract lines — a method with a track record, not a one-off plugin.
3. **Open, recomputable evidence** — every claim in this README has an on-disk artifact: gate counts in `tests/`, smoke in `tests/smoke.harness.spec.ts` against published npm versions, SHA-256SUMS manifest.

The category being crowded is stated on purpose: this plugin's value is the evidence chain and the standard-interface demonstration, not feature uniqueness.

## Channel facts (from the #9614 review — thanks @argszero)

Four properties of the guard seam that scope what this plugin's ledger and rules can claim, verified against `packages/core/tools/src/index.ts` at master (`d743267388`):

1. **The ledger is a guard-layer record, not a complete decision record.** The guard runs only when the pre-execute waterfall returned `allow` (and the user did not refuse an ask, and the call was not cancelled upstream). Denials owned by other layers never enter the guard — a complete audit record needs `tools/pre-execute` + `tools/post-execute` as writers. Our JSONL ledger describes exactly this layer and nothing more.
2. **`R-unknown` is a *name* allowlist, not a *tool* allowlist.** `execution.name` can resolve to different registered definitions across scopes (scope registrations shadow inherited entries). A same-named shadow preset is indistinguishable to the guard.
3. **PTC mode changes the traffic shape.** Model-direct calls of native tool names are denied upstream (`UNKNOWN_TOOL`) before the policy pipeline; nested sub-dispatches *do* reach the guard (inheriting `rootCallId`). Policies must therefore cover sub-dispatch argument shapes too, and the allowlist only sees what actually arrives.
4. **Structured denial metadata is channel-forced external.** A guard can only return a string; `denialInfo` in the pipeline comes from the waterfall's decision. The separate JSONL ledger is the channel's requirement, not a stylistic choice — and the refusal reason is model-facing (`Error: <reason>` is the tool result), so keep reasons short and carry the rule id (`action-guard: … (R-bounds)`) to correlate with the ledger.

**Why the guard seam (and not a `tools/pre-execute` listener):** a guard is monotonic — no other layer can force-allow what it denied — while a pre-execute listener sits in a waterfall it does not own, and one early `allow` ends the chain for everyone after it. Deterministic, synchronous, name+arguments policy belongs here; operator-visible asks belong to the waterfall.

**Mount-point note:** all guards are monotonic-deny, so the outcome is order-independent — but the *reported reason* is the first one found (global first, then scope chain farthest-first). If your policy can deny the same call from two layers, pin a single mount point to keep reported rule ids unambiguous.

## Honest scope

## Honest scope

## Honest scope

- The policy is **operator-declared** — this is not a general safety oracle, and it does not replace the harness's own permission/sandbox/approval layers; it composes with them at the guard seam.
- Same-source fix cycles are not independent stability trials. The 2009-frame gate is a mechanism demonstration, not a statistical claim.
- The guard core is a pure function (`src/guard-core.ts`, zero dependencies); the Cordis wrapper (`src/index.ts`) imports `ToolGuard` from the published `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` package and is smoke-tested as described above. One earlier revision imported a wrong internal-only package name; the smoke test against npm packages is the guard against that class of error.
- Ledger writes are best-effort and contained; they cannot affect the verdict path.

## Plugin shape (matches harness plugin conventions)

```ts
export const name = 'action-guard'
export const inject = ['tools']
export interface Config { policy: GuardPolicy; ledger?: { path: string } }
export default apply   // registers one ToolGuard via ctx.tools.guard()
```

## License

MIT.

---

**PHM evidence chain** — aggregate ledger: [phm-evidence-ledger](https://github.com/PHM-Audit/phm-evidence-ledger) (5,000,086,001 units, four layers, open metrics + SHA-256 manifest) · method parent: [agent-action-verifier](https://github.com/PHM-Audit/agent-action-verifier) (AgentDojo-validated) · [PHM-Audit profile](https://github.com/PHM-Audit)

plugins.description: Image-generation plugin for dsh: one `imagegen` tool that renders images through any OpenAI-compatible image backend
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-imagegen

Image-generation plugin for dsh: one `imagegen` tool that renders images
through any OpenAI-compatible image backend, so agents can generate images
without per-backend glue. The same tool lists the configured routes, echoes
the declared model lists, and live-probes the backends.

## Tool verbs

| verb        | network | what it does |
| ----------- | ------- | ------------ |
| `generate`  | yes     | Generates the requested images. The tool writes the image files to disk and runs magic-byte checks on them. |
| `providers` | no      | Lists the configured routes with their fields, the originating layer of each field, and the credential state. The verb reads the local configuration and makes no network request. |
| `models`    | no      | Echoes the declared model list of each route from the config layer. The verb makes no network request; the live model listing is the `status` verb. |
| `status`    | yes     | Probes each route's `GET {baseURL}/models` endpoint and reports reachability plus the live model list. |

Key `generate` behaviors:

- The `prompt` argument is required, and it is the only required argument.
- When the call omits `model`, the tool uses the route's single declared
  model. When a route declares no models, the tool resolves the model by a
  live `/models` probe. When the declared or probed model list contains
  several models, the call fails and lists the candidates.
- The tool sends `size` and `negativePrompt` verbatim, and only when the call
  sets them. The `seed` argument must be an integer, and the tool sends it
  only when the call sets it. The `n` argument is an integer >= 1 with a
  default of 1, and a value greater than 1 requests a batch.
- When the call sets `out`, the output path is that argument (a file path for
  `n = 1`, or a directory marked by a trailing separator or by existing on
  disk). When the call omits `out`, the tool writes the files to
  `<process.cwd()>/images/<unixts>_<i>.<ext>`. The file extension comes from
  the image magic bytes (`png` / `jpg` / `webp`).
- The tool checks the written bytes for PNG, JPEG, or WebP magic. When the
  payload is not a recognized image, the call fails with `code: output`, and
  the tool keeps the file on disk. When the path cannot be written, the call
  fails the same way.
- The generate timeout is 180 s by default, and a `timeout` argument of
  1-3600 s overrides it per call. The probe timeout is 10 s.

The plugin ships a `dsh-imagegen` skill. The skill is the full tool reference
for agent contexts: it carries the parameter table, the env contract, and the
error codes.

## Installation

dsh-imagegen is an out-of-tree plugin for a dsh profile. Install it with the
dsh plugin command:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-imagegen
```

Configuration is layered: built-in defaults, the `IMAGEGEN_*` env contract, a
cordis patch file, a `dsh-imagegen` settings section (see below); the plugin
creates no config or state files.

## Configuration

Providers are configured in any of four layers, lowest to highest priority;
the `providers` verb reports the originating layer of every field, so a
shadowed value is never silent:

1. the built-in default (`api: openai-compatible`),
2. the `IMAGEGEN_*` env contract (static per process boot),
3. the cordis config layer (a patch entry with id `dsh-imagegen` and a
   `config` object, or profile-level patches),
4. the `dsh-imagegen:` section in the user settings document
   (`$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`), which the plugin re-reads on every call, so
   settings edits apply without a restart.

```yaml
dsh-imagegen:
  defaultProvider: local
  providers:
    local:
      baseURL: http://<host>:<port>/v1
    hosted:
      baseURL: https://api.example.com/v1
      apiKeyEnv: IMAGEGEN_HOSTED_KEY
      models: [flux-1]
      displayName: Hosted Images
```

The env contract mirrors the config fields 1:1: `IMAGEGEN_DEFAULT_PROVIDER`,
and per route `<NAME>` the variables `IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_BASEURL`,
`IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_API`, `IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_APIKEYENV`,
`IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_HEADERS`, `IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_MODELS`,
`IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_DISPLAYNAME`. The `<NAME>` segment is the route name
uppercased with `-` written as `_`. The `headers` value is a JSON object
string, and the `models` value is a comma-separated list of model ids. The
`baseURL` value is the OpenAI-compatible base URL including the `/v1` prefix
(the same shape as an LLM provider base URL); the plugin appends
`/images/generations` and `/models` to it verbatim, and the image contract has
no server-root endpoints. The `apiKeyEnv` value is a reference to an
environment variable name, never a secret in config; per request the value
resolves from the process environment, then from
`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`.

## Examples

```jsonc
// Generate with the default route and its single declared model.
{ "verb": "generate", "prompt": "a lighthouse in fog", "size": "1024x1024" }
// Pick a route and model explicitly, and keep the output name deterministic.
{ "verb": "generate", "provider": "hosted", "model": "flux-1",
  "prompt": "an isometric pixel-art garden", "seed": 42, "out": "/tmp/garden.png" }
// Generate a batch into an existing directory.
{ "verb": "generate", "prompt": "three weather variations", "n": 3, "out": "renders/" }
// List what is configured, and where each field comes from.
{ "verb": "providers" }
// List the declared model lists per route (no network).
{ "verb": "models" }
// Probe the backend health (the live /models probe).
{ "verb": "status" }
```

## Troubleshooting

A failing call returns the document `{ ok: false, error: { code, message,
provider?, elapsed_ms } }`. The code set is `invalid_param` / `config` /
`network` / `timeout` / `http` / `protocol` / `output`.

- When a `config` error carries the message "no provider route is
  configured", no route survived configuration. Check the base URLs; the tool
  reports each route that configuration drops as a warning in the log.
- When a `config` error carries the message "credential missing: environment
  variable "X" is not set", the credential reference does not resolve. Set
  `X` in the environment or add it to `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`.
- When a `config` error carries the message "unknown provider "x"", the route
  name matches no configured route. Route names match case-insensitively and
  treat `_` and `-` as the same separator; the error lists the configured
  names.
- When a `config` error carries the message "multiple providers configured
  (...) and no default is set", pass the `provider` argument explicitly, or
  set `IMAGEGEN_DEFAULT_PROVIDER`, or set the settings `defaultProvider`.
- When an `output` error carries the message "write failed", the tool could
  not write to the `out` path. Check the directory and its permissions.
- When an `output` error carries the message "not a recognized image", the
  backend returned bytes with no PNG, JPEG, or WebP magic. Inspect the kept
  file; the backend may return an unsupported container.

## Build

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build     # tsc -> lib/
pnpm run lint      # eslint src/ test/
pnpm run selftest  # in-process: HTTP stub + config matrix + magic-byte checks
```

plugins.description: DSH 提示词工作台：优化与多轮迭代 | Prompt Studio plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-prompt-studio 提示词工作台

DSH 插件。在左栏提供一个「提示词」面板，用来优化提示词、多轮迭代、保存模板与查看历史。

对标 Prompt Optimizer 的核心能力，但只做提示词，不含图像工作区、提示词花园、MCP、多消息工作区、变量与函数测试。

## 它做什么

- **优化**：给一段原始提示词，选一个已配置的模型，拿回一个改写后的提示词。
- **迭代**：在上一版基础上按方向调整（"更简洁"、"补上输出格式约束"……），形成版本链，可回退到任意一版。方向在面板内直接填，回车即开始。
- **横向对比版本**：版本链横着排，每一版一列，内容直接铺开，不用点开就能看到；每一版都跟左边一版做行级对比，新增标绿、删除标红并划掉。
- **等待有反馈**：优化与迭代期间显示进度条和已等待秒数。
- **模板与历史**：五个内置模板（通用优化 / 结构化扩写 / 精简压缩 / 加输出格式约束 / 角色设定补全），可另存；历史按时间倒序，可筛选、删除、重新载入（载入后自动切回「优化」页）。「存入历史」把结果那一栏当前的内容存成一条手写版本；「存为模板」才是存成可复用的模板。
- **在新对话中使用**：优化结果那一栏可以直接手改；改完点「在新对话中使用」，选一个工作区，插件就会新开一个对话、把这段提示词填进输入框并直接发送，省掉复制粘贴。
- **工具**：agent 可直接调用 `prompt_optimize`。

## 它不做什么

- 不管理 API Key，不直连任何第三方服务。所有模型调用都走宿主已有的 `llm` 服务（`ctx.get('llm')`），用的是你在 DSH 里已经配好的 provider / model。
- 不引入构建步骤。宿主侧是原生 ESM，浏览器侧是手写的 bundle。
- 除了 `@deepseek-ai/*` 与 Node 内置模块，没有任何依赖。

## 安装

本插件是一个 DSH **profile bundle**，不能靠 `npm install -g` 生效——它必须被装进某个 DSH profile 才会注册面板、工具与路由。

发布到 npm 后，最简单的方式是让 DSH 自己按包名安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-prompt-studio
```

或者从源码构建出 `.tgz` 再装：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/CECILIALOVE0616/dsh-prompt-studio.git
cd dsh-prompt-studio
npm pack            # 产出 dsh-prompt-studio-<version>.tgz
```

无需 `npm install`：本插件没有运行时依赖（`dependencies` 为空），peer 依赖全部由 DSH 宿主提供。

然后用 DSH 自己的安装入口把这个 tgz 装进目标 profile。两种方式二选一：

- **桌面应用**：用宿主提供的插件安装接口装上该 `.tgz`。
- **CLI**：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-prompt-studio-<version>.tgz`。

装完重载 DSH，左栏会出现「提示词」入口。

两点注意：

- `add` 只接受包名或 `.tgz` 路径，不接受目录。
- **`desktop` profile 由 Electron 桌面应用独占管理**，CLI 对它执行 `add` 会直接报
  `profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`。桌面场景请走应用的安装接口。
- 宿主侧代码（`lib/*.js` 里除 `client.js` 外的部分）只在 DSH 启动时加载，装完必须重载；
  浏览器侧 `client.js` 每次页面加载都会从磁盘重新取，刷新即可生效。

## 设置

在 DSH 设置页的插件分区里可以改：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultMode` | `user` | 打开面板时的默认模式（用户提示词 / 系统提示词） |
| `defaultProvider` / `defaultModel` | 空 | 默认模型；留空则用会话当前路由 |
| `maxTokens` | `4096` | 单次调用的输出上限 |
| `timeoutMs` | `120000` | 单次调用超时（上限 30 分钟） |
| `maxPromptChars` | `20000` | 单条提示词长度上限 |
| `historyLimit` | `200` | 历史列表一次取多少条 |
| `toolEnabled` | `true` | 是否注册 `prompt_optimize` 工具 |

除 `toolEnabled` 外都支持热更新：改完立刻生效，不用重启。**`toolEnabled` 需要重启 DSH**——它决定工具在启动时注不注册，这类开关不享受热更新。

也可以走环境变量：`DSH_PROMPT_STUDIO_MODE` / `_PROVIDER` / `_MODEL` / `_MAX_TOKENS` / `_TIMEOUT_MS` / `_TOOL`。优先级是「插件设置 > 环境变量 > 内置默认」。

## 数据放在哪

每个工作区各自一个 SQLite 库：`<工作区>/.dsh-prompt-studio/prompt-studio.db`。三张表：

- `prompts`：提示词版本（含 `parent_id` 版本链）
- `runs`：每次模型调用（优化 / 迭代）
- `templates`：模板（内置 + 自建）

用的是 Node 内置的 `node:sqlite`，不需要额外装数据库。库是按工作区隔离的，换个项目就是另一套历史。

## 工具：`prompt_optimize`

```
prompt_optimize(prompt, mode?, direction?, provider?, model?)
  → { optimized, provider, model, elapsedMs }
```

- `prompt`：必填，原始提示词。
- `mode`：`system` 或 `user`，默认 `user`。
- `direction`：给了就按迭代模式走（在上一版基础上按方向调整），不给就是通用优化。
- `provider` / `model`：不传则用会话当前路由。传了非法值会直接报错，不会静默回退到别的模型。

调用过程中可以用 `exec.signal` 中断。

## 结构

```
lib/
  index.js    入口：Config、注册工具、挂路由、热更新钩子
  schema.js   schemastery 软导入（解构 {Schema} 会静默拿到 undefined）
  config.js   配置解析（设置 > 环境变量 > 默认），含 volatile cell 解包
  llm.js      对宿主 llm 服务的封装（streamText / listRoutes / assertRoute）
  prompts.js  提示词工程：优化 / 迭代的系统提示词，以及容错清理
  store.js    node:sqlite 存储层
  routes.js   浏览器侧 HTTP API（/dsh-prompt-studio/*）
  tools.js    prompt_optimize 工具定义
  client.js   浏览器 bundle（手写，无构建步骤）
```

## 排查

| 症状 | 原因 |
| --- | --- |
| 插件完全没出现 | `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `insert` 没并入 profile，或者没重载 DSH |
| 左栏有入口但面板打不开 | 客户端 id 与左栏项的 `id`、主区的 `key` 不一致；或 `exports.inject` 少了 `slots` |
| 设置页没有本插件的分区 | `Config` 没导出，或 schemastery 软导入拿到的不是 builder |
| `tool "prompt_optimize" is already registered` | agent preset 里重复声明了这个工具 |
| LLM 调用报 503 / undefined | `ctx.get('llm')` 是空的 |

## 许可

MIT © CECILIALOVE0616

plugins.description: 本地项目：inference-serving
plugins.readme_text:
# inference-serving

把模型 checkpoint 部署成**可访问的推理端点**，并把失败当作一等公民处理：

```
输入 → 环境探测 → 后端选择 →（迁移适配）→ 部署 → 健康检查三关
     → 注册端点 → 写共享状态
     → 失败自动降级（内存配额 → 并行度 → 精度 → 端口）→ 仍失败则回滚中止
     → 全程哈希链审计
```

- **一条命令**：`inference-serving deploy /data/models/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct`
- **幂等**：同一模型 + 同一配置重复调用返回同一端点，不重复创建
- **可回退**：`rollback` 回到上一个已验证版本
- **可清理**：`teardown` 后验证无残留进程、无残留显存、端口已释放
- **可审计**：所有调用写入 `~/.ai-infra/logs/audit/`，哈希链保护，删改可检出
- **零运行时依赖**：只用 Node 内建模块

---

## 安装

```bash
# npm（若 registry 可达）
npm install -g inference-serving

# 本机推荐：tarball 通道（不依赖公共 registry）
npm pack                       # 产出 inference-serving-0.1.0.tgz
npm install -g ./inference-serving-0.1.0.tgz
```

作为 **DSH 插件**（bundle）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/inference-serving-0.1.0.tgz
# 重启 DSH 后生效；也可用 dsh-super-injector 运行时热注入
```

运行时要求：**Node ≥ 20.11**，Linux/macOS，x64/arm64。

---

## 快速上手

```bash
inference-serving doctor                                   # 环境自检（只读）
inference-serving deploy /data/models/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct
inference-serving status                                   # 含实机核对
inference-serving list
inference-serving teardown <endpoint-id> --confirm <token>
```

部署成功后会打印端点 URL、耗时、降级步数、自动补全的假设，以及审计 id。

---

## 命令

| 命令 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `deploy <model>` | 部署为端点（幂等）。支持本地路径 / 模型 ID / URL / `env:VAR` / 已注册名 / 模糊描述 |
| `status [selector]` | 端点状态 + **实机核对**（注册表与真实载体不一致会显式报出） |
| `list [--status S]` | 列出端点 |
| `rollback <selector>` | 回退到上一个已验证版本 |
| `teardown <selector>` | 拆解并**逐项验证**无残留 |
| `migrate <model>` | 产出跨平台/跨格式迁移适配计划（只分析，不改东西） |
| `metrics` | 部署耗时、资源消耗、降级次数 |
| `audit-verify` | 校验审计哈希链完整性 |
| `reconcile [--reap]` | 孤儿载体对账（SIGKILL / 掉电后的残留；`--reap` 才真删） |
| `doctor [--deep]` | GPU / 统一内存 / Docker / 三层沙箱 / 端口池 / 策略来源 / 代理状态 |
| `install-skills [--dir]` | 把随包 SKILL.md 装到 `~/.dsh/skills/` |
| `tools` | 列出对外工具与参数 schema |

**退出码**：`0` 成功 · `1` 业务失败 · `2` 用法错误 · `3` 需要确认。

---

## MCP

本包同时提供 MCP server（stdio / streamable-http），暴露与 DSH 原生工具**完全相同**的 5 个工具：

```bash
node mcp/server.mjs                  # stdio
node mcp/server.mjs --http --port 8790   # streamable-http，POST /mcp
```

工具：`inference_serving_deploy` / `status` / `rollback` / `teardown` / `list_endpoints`
（另有运维用 `metrics` / `audit_verify` / `reconcile` / `doctor` / `migrate`）。

> DSH 在 MCP 上扮演 **client**，不会消费自家插件的 MCP server。因此 DSH 侧走原生工具注册
> （`ctx.tools.register`），MCP 侧服务**第三方客户端**；两条通道共用 `src/tools.mjs` 的同一份
> 规格与 `src/api.mjs` 的实现，不存在行为分叉。

---

## 降级链

次序：**内存配额 → 并行度 → 精度 → 端口 → 中止**。设计要点：

1. **无损在前**：配额与并行度调整不影响输出质量；精度是有损的，因此排在后面，且一旦用到，
   部署报告会显式标注 `degrade.lossy = true`。
2. **端口档正交**：端口冲突只换端口，不会白白牺牲精度。
3. **按失败原因匹配**，不是无脑顺序推进。物理上区分两类内存失败：
   - `E_INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY` —— vLLM 想申请的额度**超过宿主可给**（统一内存机型上很常见）。
     修法是**下调额度**，由「内存配额」档负责。
   - `E_MEMORY_CONFIG_INFEASIBLE` —— 额度够宿主给，但**装不下**权重 + KV。
     修法是**降低需求**（并发 / 上下文 / 精度），下调额度只会更糟。
4. **档位决策是证据驱动的**：内存配额档不是乘一个固定系数，而是拿预检算出的
   `requiredBytes / totalBytes` 反推"刚好够用"的额度（×1.35 余量）。
5. **不可降级的失败立即中止**：无 GPU、无 nvidia runtime、模型解析不了、License 待确认 ——
   重试它们只是假装在努力。

---

## 健康检查三关

`HTTP 200` 不等于模型能用。三关全过才注册端点：

| 关 | 检查 | 失败含义 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 载体存活（驱动 `inspect`） | 容器/进程已退出 |
| 2 | `GET /v1/models` 200 且列出请求的模型名 | 进程活着但引擎没起来 |
| 3 | **真实前向**：发一次最小推理请求并拿到 `choices` | 加载了但算不出东西 |

---

## 配置

### 策略文件（`~/.ai-infra/config/`）

首次运行自动生成，可直接编辑（受限 YAML 子集：字符串用双引号）：

| 文件 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `risk-classification.yaml` | 风险档 R0–R6、各档所需沙箱、确认策略与 TTL、八类系统资产写白名单 |
| `network-policy.yaml` | 出口分级与域名白名单/黑名单、代理策略、License 判定规则、端口池 |
| `headless-policy.yaml` | 无人交互时的逐项降级策略（默认全部中止） |

### 插件配置（DSH 行内 `config`）

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: inference-serving
      name: 'inference-serving'
      inject: [tools]
      config:
        root: '~/.ai-infra'
        portPoolStart: 8100
        portPoolEnd: 8199
        modelRoots: ['/data/models']
        maxDegradeSteps: 4
        headless: false
```

未知配置键、类型不符、端口池倒挂都会**在加载期响亮失败**，不静默忽略。

### 每次调用的选项

`port` / `bindHost` / `gpuMemoryUtilization` / `maxModelLen` / `maxNumSeqs` /
`servedModelName` / `image` / `backend` / `confirm` / `headless` / `deepProbe`。

**可调参数不硬编码**：判据是"能否在不改代码的情况下改变它"—— 上面每一项都可以。

---

## 权限与安全

### 能力清单

`manifest.yaml` 是**白名单**：未声明的能力拒绝（`E_CAPABILITY_DENIED`），已声明能力访问
未声明的资源也拒绝（`E_RESOURCE_NOT_DECLARED`）。

| capability | risk | 声明的资源 |
|---|---|---|
| `deploy` | write | `model:read` `gpu:write` `port:bind` `state:write` `network:egress` |
| `status` | read | `state:read` |
| `rollback` | write | `state:write` `gpu:write` `port:bind` |
| `teardown` | write | `gpu:write` `port:unbind` `state:write` |
| `list_endpoints` | read | `state:read` |
| `migrate` | write | `model:read` `gpu:write` `state:write` |

`manifest.yaml` 里的 `not_provided` 显式列出**设计上不做**的事（装驱动、提权、动别人的进程），
让审计能区分"没声明所以拒绝"与"压根不做"。

### 三层沙箱

| 风险档 | 要求 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| R0 只读 | 无 | `status` / `list_endpoints` |
| R1 低 | 进程级 | 需要可用的 `bwrap` + 非受限用户命名空间 |
| R2 中 | **容器级** | 本插件的部署路径：由插件自己驱动容器运行时 |
| R3–R5 高 | VM 级 | 系统级变更 / 生产变更 / 高风险 |

**沙箱不可用一律拒绝**（`E_SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE`），不静默降级到"没有沙箱"。
显式授权降级是可能的，但需要调用方主动传入，且会留痕警告。

> ⚠️ DSH 的 `ctx.sandbox` 服务**只管文件效果策略**，官方文档明确容器与 microVM
> 不是它的 provider。三层沙箱由本插件的驱动接缝自行实现（`src/drivers/`），
> 核心逻辑不认识 Docker。

### 系统资产保护

八类资产（文件系统 / 进程 / 网络 / 设备 / 内核 / 账户 / 服务 / 审计）逐项约束：

- **只操作自己创建的载体**：停止动作会校验 `inference-serving.managed=true` 标签，
  没有标签一律拒绝 —— 既有服务（如本机跑着的 `qwen3-embedding`）不可能被误删；
- 模型目录**只读挂载**，只允许新增，不覆盖不删除既有内容；
- 审计目录 `0700` / 文件 `0600`、只追加，模块里**不存在**删除或改写审计的 API。

### 确认机制

- R0 不问；R1/R2 **每类一次，24h 有效**；R3–R5 **每次都问**（且不进缓存）。
- 确认键包含**目标指纹**：同一 capability 对不同模型/环境不复用授权。
- 首次调用返回 `E_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` 与 `details.confirmToken`；带回该 token 才执行。
  这使"确认"成为审计里一条可追溯的事实，而不是界面上的一个弹窗。
- **顺序：能力 → 风险 → 沙箱可用性 → 确认。** 先判本机能不能做，再问用户 ——
  不该让人为一个根本执行不了的操作做确认。

### headless

无 TTY / CI 环境下默认 headless：需要确认而未获授权的操作**一律中止**
（`E_HEADLESS_NEEDS_CONFIRMATION`）。自动补全的默认值与自动选优的候选都会写进报告，
不静默。策略可通过 `headless-policy.yaml` 显式覆盖 —— 默认全 `abort`。

### 网络出口

- **不信任环境代理**：所有出网走 `node:http`（天然不读 `HTTP(S)_PROXY`）。
  本机那个代理 CONNECT 能建立但上游 TLS 必失败，信任它每次会白等 10 秒。
- 白名单直连（国内镜像）；白名单外 = `ask`（headless 下等价拒绝）；
  黑名单**根本不发连接**。
- License 判定：宽松自动继续；受限/缺失**停下确认**。

---

## 共享状态

```
~/.ai-infra/
  state/serving-registry.yaml     端点与版本历史（文件锁 + 原子写，写前留快照）
  state/confirmations.json        确认授权（TTL）
  state/metrics.json              指标
  state/history/                  注册表快照（最多 20 份）
  logs/audit/inference-serving/   审计，{date}.jsonl，哈希链
  logs/inference-serving/         结构化运行日志
  config/*.yaml                   策略
  run/inference-serving/          锁与临时文件
```

状态**不放在包内** —— npm 安装后的包目录是只读的，且升级会覆盖。

---

## 可观测性

- **结构化日志**：JSONL，阶段事件（`phase:probe` / `phase:deploy` / `phase:degrade` …）带耗时；
- **指标**：`deploy_ms_total` / `deploy_ms_max` / `degrade_steps` / `degrade.by_reason` /
  `last_gpu_memory_utilization` 等；
- **HTTP 端点**（挂载为 DSH 插件且 `webServer` 可用时）：
  `GET /api/inference-serving/status`。

---

## 健壮性

| 机制 | 做法 |
|---|---|
| 故障隔离 | `api.*` 永不抛异常，只回结构化错误；每个工具独立注册，单个失败不影响其它 |
| 超时 | 每个操作有明确超时；部署/健康检查用**墙钟**约束，不用调用次数 |
| 取消 | 全链路透传 `AbortSignal`，取消时清理已创建的资源 |
| 优雅关闭 | 卸载时排空在途操作（drain timeout），超时报告未完成数量 |
| 中断清理 | 退出钩子（exit/SIGINT/SIGTERM/uncaughtException）+ `reconcile` 兜住 SIGKILL |
| 可回退 | 每次写注册表前留快照；部署失败回收载体并验证端口释放 |

---

## 与 DSH 插件契约的一处刻意偏离

官方要求插件配置使用 Schemastery `Schema<Config>`。本包是**零运行时依赖**包，为不引入
`@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 硬依赖，改为手写校验并在非法配置时**加载期直接抛错**（语义等价：
非法配置响亮失败），可调参数则全部外置到策略文件与调用选项。

其余契约逐条遵守：`name` + `apply` + `inject`；一切注册走 `ctx.effect()`；
只硬依赖 `tools`，`webServer` 用 `ctx.get()` 可选取用（headless profile 也能挂载）。

---

## 开发

```bash
npm test              # 单元 + 集成（131 个用例，不需要 GPU/Docker）
npm run test:unit
npm run test:integration
npm run check         # 包规范自检
npm run demo          # 真机端到端演示（需要 Docker + NVIDIA GPU）
```

集成测试用 `tests/helpers/` 里的**测试后端 + spawn 驱动**跑完整闭环，
不依赖 GPU 与 Docker —— 这同时是"软硬件解耦"的验收证据。

## License

MIT

## 兼容性

| 项 | 范围 |
|---|---|
| Node.js | >= 20.11 |
| DSH | `engines.dsh: ">=0.2.0 <0.3.0"`，已在 **0.2.0-rc.2** 上验证 |
| 操作系统 | Linux / macOS（x64 / arm64）；Windows 未验证 |
| 运行时依赖 | 零（只用 Node 内建模块与外部容器运行时） |
| 容器后端 | Docker 或 Podman（部署真实端点时需要；单元测试不需要） |

跨包契约套件（`inference-contracts`）属于本机 monorepo 的内部闸门：单独 clone 本仓库时
`npm run test:contract` 会明确跳过，不会伪装成通过。

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)
