plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-paid-poop 带薪拉屎

[![DeepSeek Harness plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-dsh--plugin-blue)](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)

> 带薪拉屎 / 带薪如厕 / Paid Poop / paid toilet break timer —— 一个 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：悬浮按钮记录每次拉屎时长，按月薪、单双休、法定节假日自动算出这次带薪拉屎赚了多少钱。

**关键词**：带薪拉屎 · 带薪如厕 · 带薪蹲坑 · 摸鱼 · 带薪拉屎计算器 · 上班如厕计时 · paid poop · paid toilet break · salary timer · work shirk · bathroom break earnings · DeepSeek Harness · dsh plugin · dsh 插件

## 功能一览

- **悬浮球计时**：点一下开始、再点一下结束并结算；支持拖拽移位（位置记忆）与自定义尺寸（36–96px）。
- **真实薪酬结算**：月薪 ÷ 当月工作日 ÷ 日工时，跨午休自动扣减，仅工作时段计薪（可关），支持双休 / 单休 / 大小周。
- **法定节假日与调休**：内置 2025、2026 年国务院办公厅官方放假调休表，节假日不计薪、补班日照常计薪；可自定义补班/放假日（年假、事假）。
- **统计面板**：今日/本月次数、总收益、平均时长、单次最高、月薪回本率、每日收益柱状图、历史记录、手动补记。
- **拉屎提醒**：设定提醒时刻（默认 10:30 / 15:30），面板弹窗 + 可选浏览器系统通知。
- **中英双语**、零构建纯 JS、数据全部存浏览器 localStorage（不上传、不落盘）。

## 安装

### 方式一：本地目录安装（推荐开发者）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:<本仓库绝对路径>
```

或在 DSH 会话里让 Agent 用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle` 传本仓库绝对路径。安装后刷新 `http://127.0.0.1:3080` 即可在右下角看到悬浮球。

### 方式二：从 awesome 列表安装

本插件已提交至 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) 收录列表（`fun` 分类），可通过 [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) 等插件市场一键安装。

## 用法

- **悬浮球**：空闲时显示当日累计收益，点击开始计时；计时中显示实时金额与脉冲外圈，再点一下结束并结算。**按住可拖动到任意位置**（拖 5px 内算点击，位置自动记忆，下次打开仍在原处）。**尺寸可在设置 Tab 调整**（36–96px 滑杆，实时生效）。
- **面板**：点悬浮球右上角的 ☰ 展开四个 Tab——今日（次数/总时长/总收益/平均/非带薪 + 明细）、本月（日均次数/最长/单次最高/月薪回本率 + 每日收益柱状图）、记录（按日分组、逐条删除、手动补记）、设置。
- **提醒**：到达提醒时刻时面板弹 toast + 悬浮球脉冲；可选开启浏览器系统通知（首次打开开关时申请权限）。

## 计算口径

```
秒薪 = 月薪 ÷ 当月工作日数（或固定 21.75）÷ 每日工时秒数
每日工时 = (下班 − 上班) − (午休，若启用)
```

- 工作制：双休（周一~五）/ 单休（周一~六）/ 大小周（按基准周推算单双休周）。
- **法定节假日与调休**：内置 2025、2026 年国务院办公厅官方放假/调休表（国办发明电〔2024〕12号、〔2025〕7号）——法定假日照常的工作日不计薪，周末补班日照常计薪；未收录年份自动回退纯星期判定，并在设置页提示。
- **自定义日期**：设置里可添加「补班日」（如公司调休）与「放假日」（年假、事假等），优先级高于星期判定与内置年表。
- 计薪区间：仅工作时段（可关闭，关闭后按全天计薪）；跨午休自动扣除重叠部分。
- 非工作日 / 非工作时段的记录照常落库但收益为 0（标注原因）。
- 跨天的记录归属**开始日**；短于 3 秒视为误触不记录；超过 4 小时结算前需确认。
- 不扣五险一金，薪资按税前口径；官方年表按年更新（新年份公告发布后更新插件，或用自定义日期临时补充）。

## 数据与隐私

- 全部数据存在**浏览器 localStorage**，键 `dshPaidPoop.v1`，不上传、不落 Host。
- 记录保留最近 730 天；设置页可**导出 JSON 备份**、**清空数据**。
- 存储损坏时自动备份到 `dshPaidPoop.v1.corrupt` 并按默认值重建；隐私模式下降级为内存态并提示。

## 清空方式

设置 Tab → 清空数据（二次确认）；或在浏览器控制台执行 `localStorage.removeItem('dshPaidPoop.v1')`。

## 相关链接

- 收录列表：[awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)（DeepSeek Harness 插件精选）
- 插件市场：[dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market)

plugins.description: An unofficial whale-girl companion for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar brand mark plus a draggable, collapsible floating mascot with live token usage.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-whale-girl

An unofficial **whale-girl (鲸鱼娘) companion** for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
She replaces the sidebar brand mark and floats over the page as a draggable,
collapsible mascot: her head follows your cursor, she reacts to pats and clicks,
she follows what the agent is doing, and her speech bubble reports the current
session's real token usage.

![whale-girl](assets/whale-girl-768.webp)

> The character is community fan art, not an official DeepSeek asset — see
> [Source & attribution](#source--attribution). Chinese docs: [README.zh.md](README.zh.md).

## What she does

| Area | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Sidebar brand mark (`sidebar.brand.mark`) | Replaces the stock fish logo with a close-up of her face (`avatar-face.png`). Registered with `priority: -1` so it wins the single-value slot. |
| Floating companion (`shell.overlay`) | A 220×298 paper doll over the frame, with a token card above her and speech bubbles. Drag her anywhere inside the frame (position kept in `localStorage['whale-girl:position']`); double-click returns her to the bottom-right corner and forgets the position; when the window shrinks she is folded back into view. |
| Gaze | Her head turns towards the pointer (up to ±7°) and her tail counter-swings (±4.8°); both settle back to centre 0.22 s after the pointer leaves. The pivot is measured from the eyes/lashes in the art, not from the bounding box. |
| Pat | Press and hold ≥ 350 ms: a one-shot squash-and-return animation plus a dedicated line. She does **not** fold away. |
| Click and combo | A quick click (< 350 ms) folds or unfolds her, with an answering line; 3–4 fast clicks get a counted complaint; the 5th click fires a one-shot easter egg. |
| Mood | `data-mood` follows context occupancy: `<50%` `calm`, `≥50%` `tense`, `≥85%` `crit`. Each crossing drops a 💦 in her corner for 2.6 s. |
| Speech | Lines are triggered by state and filled with real numbers from DSH's own session projections (`tokenUsage`, `contextPressure`): a greeting on mount, an answer on click, live progress while the turn is producing output, a context warning at 80 %, and a "done" line 2.5 s after output stops. She never calls the network or the model. |
| Token card | Context occupancy (bar plus `tokens / window`) and output / input / cache-read counts for the current session — the same projections the composer's own indicator uses. Hidden when there is no session; it yields when the window is narrower than 900 px. |
| Three-layer puppet | Her body, head and tail are separate layers that are pixel-identical to the still illustration at rest, so they are invisible until she moves. |

Animations run only while she is being interacted with: exactly three one-shot
`@keyframes` (`wg-pat` / `wg-egg` / `wg-emote`), no `infinite`, no `alternate`,
no `will-change`; `getAnimations()` is empty when idle.

## Install

The package declares a `dsh.bundle` patch, so installing it mounts both halves —
no profile editing, no manual copy:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Turanbuturan/dsh-agent-whale-girl
```

`--profile desktop` is the DSH desktop app; use `--profile web` for a plain web
profile. A release tarball or a local checkout works the same way:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-agent-whale-girl
```

Reload the page afterwards. Host-side changes need a full app restart (Node's ESM
cache pins the module path), but this plugin's host half is empty — a page
refresh is enough.

### Manual drop-in

Copy the folder into `<profile>/plugins/` and add the row to the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: whale-girl
      name: "./plugins/dsh-agent-whale-girl/index.js"
```

The path resolves against the profile directory. Removing the `insert` row (and
refreshing) removes her; the folder may stay in place.

### Uninstall

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-agent-whale-girl
```

If you used the manual drop-in instead, delete the `insert` row and refresh.

## Build and verify

`lib/client.js` and `lib/client.css` are committed, so installing needs no build
step. To rebuild after changing the art or the skeleton:

```sh
node build.mjs            # regenerates lib/client.js + lib/client.css from the PNGs and layers.json
node verify-bundle.cjs lib/client.js
```

`verify-bundle.cjs` is a structural and behavioural self-check (registrations,
injected CSS, layer geometry, gaze maths, click/pat/combo timing, mood values).
Use absolute paths — the script resolves the bundle relative to the working
directory.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | Declares `dsh.bundle.patch` (installable bundle) and `dsh.client.platform = "web"` (browser half). |
| `index.js` | Host half: an intentionally empty `apply()` so the loader can mount the package. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | The mount declaration read at install time. |
| `lib/client.js` / `lib/client.css` | Build output: the client bundle that registers both slots, and the stylesheet it injects. |
| `build.mjs` | Builds the two files above from the PNGs and `layers.json` (inlines the art, writes the skeleton geometry into CSS). |
| `layers.json` | Puppet skeleton: crop boxes, rotation origins in the 414×560 art space, amplitudes, measured pivots. |
| `verify-bundle.cjs` | Self-check. |
| `avatar-body.png` / `avatar-head.png` / `avatar-tail.png` | The three puppet layers. |
| `avatar-face.png` | 96×96 face crop used by the 24 px mark and the folded bubble. |
| `avatar.png` | The full-body illustration before cutting. |
| `assets/` | Source art. |

## Source & attribution

The code is MIT. The character art is community fan art and keeps the terms of
the repositories it came from:

- [`Neko3000/deepseek-whalechan`](https://github.com/Neko3000/deepseek-whalechan) — MIT — **the art used now**; cut into layers and background-removed here.
- [`TreapGoGo/deepseek-whale-girl`](https://github.com/TreapGoGo/deepseek-whale-girl) — MIT — the earlier chibi avatar (`assets/whale-girl-avatar-512.png`).
- [`fornarwhal/deepseek-whale-girl-icon`](https://github.com/fornarwhal/deepseek-whale-girl-icon) — custom terms — reviewed as a candidate icon source, not shipped.

See [NOTICE](NOTICE) for the file-by-file mapping. "DeepSeek" and the DeepSeek
whale logo belong to their respective owners; this plugin is an unofficial
community project.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: show a running / just-finished indicator on sidebar workspace rows
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workspace-activity

**English** · [简体中文](README.zh.md)

Marks each workspace in the sidebar while one of its sessions is running.

A session row already shows a spinner while it runs. This plugin puts the same
spinner on the **workspace row above it**, so a collapsed or scrolled workspace
list still tells you which project is busy without expanding anything.

```
📁 dsh-workspace                    ◌      ← added by this plugin
   ◌ 处理所有 skill 同步到已同步      刚刚
```

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-workspace-activity
```

Restart dsh, or reload the page. The plugin is a bundle, so it also works
through the plugin market and any other bundle-aware client.

## What it does

The sidebar shows no indicator on a workspace row today. The plugin derives one
from the same status feed the session rows use, so the two agree:

- A workspace is marked when at least one of its sessions is running.
- Subagent sessions are skipped. The sidebar folds them into their parent's row
  and never draws one of its own, and their ids belong to no workspace, so a mark
  from one would have no row to sit on.
- Sessions the sidebar hides as archived are skipped. This matches the default
  view. The sidebar's archive filter can also show archived sessions, and the
  plugin cannot see which setting is active — it is not part of what
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` exposes — so with the filter set to show
  archived sessions, a running archived row can appear under an unmarked
  workspace.
- The status feed is authoritative; the session list is the fallback, matching
  the precedence the workspace browser itself uses.
- The mark is a spinner at the row's trailing edge, in the same 16px slot the
  session rows use for their timestamps, drawn with the product's own theme
  token and stroke geometry.
- A **collapsed** workspace also tints its folder glyph with the same blue the
  browser paints on the group you are inside. Collapsed rows hide their
  sessions, so the glyph has to carry the state alone; an expanded row already
  shows its sessions and keeps the browser's own colouring.
- Readers who cannot see it get the count and the workspace names through a
  visually hidden description.

## How it works

A workspace row declares no slot, so there is no supported place to render into.
The plugin instead contributes a stylesheet that decorates the row the sidebar
already renders. It writes nothing to the document, observes nothing, and appends
no nodes: the rule targets the row's trailing pseudo-element and React keeps
owning the row.

This is the one thing to know before installing it: **the rule targets the
sidebar's `data-row-key` attribute**, which is an internal detail of
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` rather than a published contract. If a
future release renames it, the spinner stops appearing until the plugin is
updated. Nothing else breaks — the plugin never mutates the DOM, so a stale
selector degrades to "no indicator", not to a broken sidebar.

## Requirements

- A Web (or desktop) client — this is a client-only plugin, `dsh.client.platform: web`.
- No host services, no configuration, no permissions.

## Development

Written in TypeScript; `src/` is the source of truth and `lib/` is generated
(and committed — see below). The scripts under `scripts/` are TypeScript too and
run straight through Node's type stripping, which needs Node 22.18 or newer; no
separate runner is involved.

```sh
npm install
npm run build     # tsdown -> lib/, then wraps the Client half in the module envelope
npm run check     # typecheck + lint + format check + build + verify
```

| Script                    | What it does                                                     |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `build`                   | Emits `lib/index.js` and `lib/client.js`.                        |
| `verify`                  | Loads the built Client half and renders it with a real renderer. |
| `typecheck`               | `tsc --noEmit`.                                                  |
| `lint` / `lint:fix`       | Oxlint, type-aware, with the React hooks rules.                  |
| `format` / `format:check` | Prettier.                                                        |
| `check`                   | Everything above, in the order CI would run it.                  |

`build` runs `scripts/wrap-client.ts` after tsdown: the Client half has to
reach the browser as a `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` call
whose `id` is the package name, and the wrapper supplies that envelope.

`lib/` is committed on purpose, and this package deliberately declares no
lifecycle script. pnpm refuses to install a git-hosted package that has one
unless the consumer allowlists it, which would make the plugin uninstallable
straight from the repository; with no script to run, `add` simply consumes the
committed output. Run `npm run build` after changing `src/`.

`verify` is not a mock of the sidebar. It captures the factory the envelope
registers, drives `apply` against a stub context, and renders the registered
component with `react-test-renderer` — enough to prove the envelope, the
registration, and the stylesheet the entry publishes. The running sidebar is
still the only place the indicator's position and colour can be judged.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: This repo is a deepseek harness plugin for routing auto review (@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review) reuqests to user specified model
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-auto-review-model-router

Route DSH's experimental **auto-review** safety gate to a model you choose, so a
premium agent model does not pay for its own safety reviews.

```yaml
# <profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- insert:
    - id: auto-review-model-router
      name: dsh-auto-review-model-router
      config:
        reviewModel: deepseek-official/deepseek-flash
```

With that entry every review runs on `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash` while the
agent keeps `claude-opus-4`, `gpt-6-astra`, or whatever else the session selected.

## The problem it solves

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review` reviews each gated tool call by
calling `ctx.llm.stream()` on **the session's own route**: it copies `provider`
and `model` out of the session request header
(`snapshotAutoReview()` in `packages/experimental/auto-review/src/index.ts`).
There is no `reviewModel` field in the shipped plugin, so an expensive agent
model is charged for one extra full review request per gated call.

## How it works

The plugin wraps two service methods at activation: `llm.stream` always, and
`llm.prepareCall` unless `wrapPrepareCall` is off.

1. A request is recognized as an auto-review call when it is **hand-built**
   (it does not carry the agent loop's own-request mark) **and** its `system`
   prompt starts with auto-review's fixed `REVIEW_POLICY` opening. Only such a
   request is ever rewritten.
2. It is copied onto `reviewModel`, and the source route's `reasoningEffort` and
   `maxTokens` are dropped. Both are properties of the *agent's* model: a
   reasoning effort the target does not declare makes the harness throw
   `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT`, and an inherited output cap can exceed the
   target's limit. Either would fail every review closed.
3. Everything else — the review prompt, its policy system prompt, `temperature`,
   and the `{"risk":…,"decision":…}` JSON protocol the gate parses — is
   unchanged. Only the model that produces the verdict changes.
4. A review that fails transiently is retried on the same route
   (`retryAttempts`, default 4). The gate calls `llm.stream` directly, outside
   the agent loop, so the harness retry plugin (an `agent/request-error`
   listener) never sees a review: without this, one dropped connection denies
   the tool call.

### Why retries need their own classification

Only the codes the harness itself treats as transient are retried:
`EMPTY_RESPONSE`, `RATE_LIMIT`, `SERVER`, `TRANSPORT`. `TIMEOUT` is deliberately
excluded — the DeepSeek adapter raises it from an **idle watchdog**, so retrying
it multiplies a silent wait by the attempt count while the auto-review deadline
drains. `ABORTED` (the deadline, or the caller cancelling) and configuration
errors such as `AUTH` are not fixed by trying again.

A failed attempt's terminal `finish` chunk is held back: the gate's reader ends
the review on any terminal `finish`, so yielding it would end the review on the
first transport blip. Reasoning chunks stay live (the reader ignores reasoning
content), so a retried review exposes more than one attempt's reasoning while the
verdict is still parsed from the final text block alone.

### Why the wrappers, and not an `llm/stream` listener

Two seams were tried first and both are dead ends on a real runtime:

- Mutating the request inside an `llm/stream` listener throws: auto-review
  freezes it (`deepFreeze`) before streaming.
- Returning `next(replacement)` from a listener never reaches the adapter:
  Cordis's `EventsService.waterfall` invokes the innermost callback with the
  argument list it closed over.
- Writing `ctx.llm.stream = wrapper` is also ineffective: `ctx.llm` is a
  per-read traceable proxy, and its property overlay shadows what you write.

The wrappers are therefore installed on the object that owns each method in the
service's prototype chain (`LlmRuntime.prototype` in practice), which is the one
seam every consumer actually calls. Both are removed when the plugin's fiber
disposes.

### Why `prepareCall` needs its own wrapper

A prepared handle resolves its route during `prepareCall` and then rejects a
dispatch whose config differs from the resolved one
(`INVALID_PREPARED_CALL`). The retarget must therefore happen *before* the call
is prepared; swapping the route in the returned handle cannot work. With
`wrapPrepareCall: true` (the default) a review prepared that way runs on the
review route, and turning it off restores the session route for that path.

## Install

Published on npm as `dsh-auto-review-model-router`:

```sh
# in the profile directory
pnpm add dsh-auto-review-model-router
```

From a local checkout instead, link it:

```jsonc
// <profile>/package.json
"dependencies": { "dsh-auto-review-model-router": "link:D:/path/to/dsh-auto-review-model-router" }
```

Then insert it in the profile patch layer, after the auto-review bundle:

```yaml
# <profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- insert:
    - id: auto-review-model-router
      name: dsh-auto-review-model-router
      config:
        reviewModel: deepseek-official/deepseek-flash
```

Restart the app: patch-layer changes apply at profile startup.

## Configuration

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `reviewModel` | `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash` | `<provider>/<model>` every review runs on. An empty string disables routing. |
| `systemPromptPatterns` | the shipped `REVIEW_POLICY` opening | Substrings, or `/regex/u` literals, matched against a request's `system` prompt. Widen this only if a harness release rewrites that prompt. |
| `retryAttempts` | `4` | Retries after the first attempt of one review call, so up to 5 attempts. `0` disables retrying. Maximum 10. |
| `retryDelayMs` | `500` | Pause before each retry. |
| `wrapPrepareCall` | `true` | Also route review requests issued through `llm.prepareCall`. |
| `dropReasoningEffort` | `true` | Drop the source route's reasoning effort on the review request. |
| `dropMaxTokens` | `true` | Drop the source route's output cap on the review request. |
| `logRetargets` | `true` | Log each retargeted review. Retries log a warning regardless. |

## Verify

The test suite has two files. `test/router.test.js` covers the decision surface
with no harness at all; `test/live.test.js` runs the wrappers over the real
`LlmRuntime` and skips those checks when neither this package nor
`DSH_PROFILE_DIR` resolves `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`.

```sh
node test/router.test.js
DSH_PROFILE_DIR=<profile dir> node test/live.test.js
```

Two commands rather than `node --test`: each file runs its `node:test` suite
in-process, while `node --test` spawns a child process per file.

> The plugin patches `LlmRuntime.prototype`, so each live test disposes its own
> mount. Skipping that teardown leaks a wrapper into the next test's dispatches.

At runtime each retarget logs one line, and each retry logs a warning:

```
auto-review-model-router: review request re-routed anthropic/claude-opus-4 -> deepseek-official/deepseek-flash (stream)
auto-review-model-router: review attempt 1/5 failed with TRANSPORT; retrying in 500 ms
```

## Scope and limits

- Only requests recognized as auto-review calls change route. A false negative
  costs nothing (the review runs exactly as before); a false positive is bounded
  to one extra object and one changed route for one hand-built request.
- The standalone `dsh-auto-review` plugin needs none of this: its `reviewerModel`
  config field already sets the reviewer's model directly.
- DSH public APIs are pre-stable. A release that changes the `REVIEW_POLICY`
  opening, `LlmRuntime.prototype`'s method names, or the prepared-handle contract
  needs a matching update here. Detection is configurable
  (`systemPromptPatterns`) precisely for the first case, and the plugin logs a
  warning instead of failing the profile boot when a method it needs is missing.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH handoff plugin: /handoff generates a structured handoff card, auto-numbered new chat, sidebar pinning, threshold auto-prepare.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-xwide-handoff

> 给 **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** 用的交接插件：一条 `/handoff` 把「快聊满的会话」变成「一张结构化交接卡 + 一个干净的新会话」，并在侧栏自动置顶。上下文快满时还能**自动把下一棒备好**。

[![version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/XWIDE/dsh-xwide-handoff?include_prereleases&label=%E7%89%88%E6%9C%AC)](https://github.com/XWIDE/dsh-xwide-handoff/releases/latest)
[![status](https://img.shields.io/badge/%E7%8A%B6%E6%80%81-beta-orange)](docs/INSTALL.md)
[![platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%E6%8F%92%E4%BB%B6-blue)](https://github.com/XWIDE/dsh-xwide-handoff)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)

**中文（本页）** · [English](README.en.md) · [安装与使用指南](docs/INSTALL.md) · [更新日志](CHANGELOG.md) · [MIT License](LICENSE)

> **状态：v0.2.2 · beta。** 核心流程（`/handoff` → 交接卡 → 新会话 → 自增命名 → 置顶）在作者机器上长期在用；跨机器安装路径（尤其 `childMode: none`）**尚未在第二台机器验证**。安装两步、配置项表、五条故障排查见 [安装与使用指南](docs/INSTALL.md)。

---

## 它解决什么问题

长任务会把会话上下文顶满。官方的自动压缩是**有损**的：它会把细节吃掉，而且压完你还在同一个会话里，继续顶。

这个插件换一条路 —— **交接**：

1. 把「当前做到哪一步 / 改过哪些文件 / 验证过什么 / 下一步做什么」写成一张**交接卡**；
2. 起一个**上下文清零的新会话**，把卡片作为它的第一句；
3. 新会话**自动命名**（`原会话名_01`、`_02`…，落盘计数器，不重名）、**自动置顶**、**自动归入源会话所在的项目分组**。

于是你换了个房间，但接力棒没丢。

## 安装

```bash
# 在 DSH profile 目录里
pnpm add dsh-xwide-handoff
```

**下载即用（不需要 npm / pnpm）**：把本仓库整个目录放进 `<你的 profile>\local-plugins\dsh-x-wide_handoff\`，然后在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 末尾加一行挂载，**重启 DSH**：

```yaml
- id: dsh-xwide-handoff
  name: './local-plugins/dsh-x-wide_handoff/index.js'
  config:
    enabled: true
    commandName: handoff
    childMode: create
    recentUserMessages: 6
```

> ⚠️ **只能有一个装载实例**：包自带 patch 插一条 + profile 再直装一条 = 两个实例（命令注册两次、watcher 双份）。现象是启动日志里 `/handoff registered` 打印两次。详见 [故障排查①](docs/INSTALL.md)。

## 用法

指令菜单里能看到 `handoff` 这一条（说明命令已注册），或在输入框直接敲 `/handoff`：

![DSH 指令菜单里的 handoff 命令](docs/img/handoff-command.png)

```
/handoff 本次重点：把 X 的解析逻辑改完；已改 a.js；未验证回归
```

- `/handoff` 后面写的内容会进卡片的「本次交接重点」。
- **不写也行** —— 卡片会自动带上「本轮动过的文件」和「你最近 6 条原话」。
- 命令执行完会告诉你新会话的 id 和标题，并把它置顶。

**注意**：`/handoff` 是斜杠命令，**只能由用户在输入框敲**，模型不能自己调用。所以插件同时提供 A 半自动（见下），到阈值时**替你把它备好**。

## A 半自动（`autoReady`）

打开后，插件监听每一轮的结束（`turn/end`），读最近一次请求携带的上下文量：

```
占用 = 最近一条 assistant/message 的 usage.inputTokens ÷ contextWindow
```

- **≥ `readyPct`（默认 0.7）** → 自动跑一遍交接：建会话、命名、置顶、注入卡片、驱动它跑完首轮（这样它在侧栏里**一定看得见**）。
- **不替你切会话** —— 你从侧栏点那条置顶的新会话继续。DSH 没有「服务端让浏览器换会话」的公开接口，这是有意的边界。
- 保险丝：同一会话只备一次、全局冷却（默认 10 分钟）、总开关默认**关**。

> ⚠️ 判占用**必须**用 `inputTokens`。`usage.totalTokens` 是累计消耗（见过 20 万），拿它判会 100% 误触。

## 配置

```yaml
- id: dsh-xwide-handoff
  name: './local-plugins/dsh-x-wide_handoff/index.js'
  config:
    commandName: handoff          # 命令名，默认 handoff
    childMode: create             # none | create | fork（见下）
    recentUserMessages: 6         # 卡片带最近几条你的原话
    compact: false                # 交接前是否先本地压缩一次（本地大模型请保持 false）
    titleTemplate: '{base}_{seq}' # 标题模板，支持 {base} {seq} {note} {time}
    seqWidth: 2                   # 序号位数：_01
    maxTitleChars: 64             # 标题字符上限
    repinLimit: 3                 # 自愈重钉次数上限
    autoReady: false              # A 半自动总开关
    readyPct: 0.7                 # 触发阈值（占上下文窗口比例）
    readyCooldownMs: 600000       # 冷却
    contextWindow: 262144         # 上下文窗口（判占用用；默认取自作者的本地模型，请按自己窗口改）
    cardSections:                 # 卡片栏目开关
      guide: true                 # 「接手须知」
      files: true                 # 「本轮动过的文件」
      usage: true                 # 「源会话上下文」
```

### `childMode` 三档

| 值 | 行为 | 什么时候用 |
|---|---|---|
| `create` | 服务端直接建**全新空会话**（上下文清零，继承 cwd 与 agentPreset） | **默认推荐**。不依赖客户端半边 |
| `none` | 服务端不建会话，把卡片 JSON 塞进结果文本，由 `client.js` 用 GUI 原生 API 建**可见**会话 | 需要「和点『新建对话』完全一致」时；要求 `client.js` 已正确作为 `dsh.client` 打进包，**跨机器未验证** |
| `fork` | 继承全部历史（上下文**不**清零） | 只想换个标题、不想清上下文的场景 |

> ⚠️ 三种模式都**不能**带 `parentSession` —— DSH 会把带 `parentSession` 的会话从列表和可恢复集合里排除，那正是「交接完看不见新会话」的经典成因。

## 交接卡长什么样

```markdown
调节Qwen3.8 Agent对接本地模型_07          ← 第一行 = 目标标题（官方取名启发式直接取它）

# 交接卡 · 调节Qwen3.8 Agent对接本地模型_07

## 接手须知（先读这一段）
1. 先读完整卡片：源会话 cwd 下的 handoff/ 目录里最新那份 .md 就是本卡全文
2. 先报计划再动手：一句话说清先做哪条、大约要多久、有没有分支
3. 不要重复已完成步骤：下面「本轮动过的文件」都改过了，先读现状
4. 拿不准就去查证：文件、目录、会话记录都在磁盘上

- 源会话上下文：约 18461 tokens（最近一次请求携带量；判占用看它，不看累计消耗）

## 本轮动过的文件（3 个，自动提取自 5 次 write/edit 调用）
- `C:\…\local-plugins\dsh-x-wide_handoff\index.js`（write×1 edit×4）

## 最近你的原话（逐条原文，按时间顺序）
1. …
```

## 工作原理（给要改代码的人）

- **命名**：序号来自落盘计数器（`~/.dsh/named-handoff-counter.json`，按 cwd 分桶单调递增），**不是**从源会话标题尾号推算 —— 源会话每次都是新开的、标题没有尾号，推算永远得到 `_01`。名单落在 `~/.dsh/named-handoff-names.json`。
- **钉名三通道**：① 卡片第一行就是目标标题（官方取名服务会读它）；② `ctx.sessions.using(...).binding.session.rename()`（部分版本没有 `using`，会失败）；③ `session.append("session/title", …)`。
- **自愈重钉**：官方取名服务会主动覆盖已钉住的标题（其注释自认 "overwriting a pinned user title is the point"），所以插件监听改名事件，发现名单内会话被非 user 来源改名就再钉一次（上限 `repinLimit`）。
- **`prompt` 需要 signal**：`sessionController.prompt(request, signal)` 的包装层第一行就调 `signal.throwIfAborted()`，务必传 `new AbortController().signal`。
- **`blank` 只认 `turn/start`**：侧栏会把 `blank: true` 的会话直接滤掉（标题还会显示成「新建会话」）。注入消息不会翻这个标记，所以必须真的驱动一轮。

## 兼容性

本插件使用了若干 **DSH 内部接口**（不是稳定公开契约），已在下列位置核对过：

| 用到的东西 | 位置（DSH 桌面版内置包） |
|---|---|
| `sessionController.prompt / create / resolveAgent` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller` |
| `session.append` 的 `surfaceOp` 语义 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session`（`SURFACE_EVENT_TYPES` 只有 system/developer/user/assistant/message + tool/result） |
| `system/message` 必须是 surface 第一条 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v3-to-v4` `foldSurface()` |
| `workspaceRegistry.pinSession` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace` |
| `projectController.baseline / assign` | `dsh-project-groups`（**可选依赖**，没装就跳过归组） |
| 侧栏 `blank` 过滤 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` |

**DSH 升级后请复核上表**。所有内部调用都写了宽容处理：失败只记日志，不让交接本身崩掉。

## 路线图

- [ ] `childMode: "none"` 客户端半边的完整接线与回归
- [ ] 卡片栏目可自定义模板
- [ ] 交接卡自动带上「已跑过的关键命令」
- [ ] 发布到 npm / DSH 插件市场，实现一键安装

# dsh-integration-settings [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![DSH supported through 0.2.0-rc.2](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-up%20to%200.2.0--rc.2-2563eb.svg)](#环境要求) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-339933.svg)](#环境要求) **简体中文** | [English](README.en.md) 给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）**设置**里补上四个可视化菜单。主打**一键解锁思考模式**——自动识别每个 OpenAI 兼容网关真正支持的思考档位，写进模型选择器（也可以设成定时自动更新）；另外三个菜单把平时只能手改文件的事变成点选操作： | 设置菜单 | 管什么 | 背后落盘位置 | | --- | --- | --- | | **MCP 管理** | 增 / 删 / 改 / 启停 MCP 服务器 | 当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（受管区块）+ `.dsh-integration/mcp.json`（真理源） | | **Skill 管理** | 浏览 / 新建 / 编辑 / 删除技能 | DSH 全局、共享 `.agents`、Claude / Codex 全局目录，以及当前项目的 `.dsh` / `.agents` / `.claude` 目录 | | **全局人设** | 可视化编辑人设文件（等价于 Claude Code 的 `CLAUDE.md`） | `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`（全局）与 `<项目>/AGENTS.md`（当前项目） | | **思考解锁** | 打开即自动识别每个网关真正支持的思考档位，一键解锁写回配置；也可设成定时自动更新（默认每 6 小时，仅 DSH 运行期间生效）；可新增/编辑网关（不提供删除） | 当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（`llm-pi-ai` 条目的 `config.providers`）+ `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`（`refs`，只存密钥） | > 这是社区插件，不是 DeepSeek 官方产品。安装前请自行评估，建议先备份 profile 目录。 ## 环境要求 - **DSH 桌面版 0.2.0-rc.2**（本插件按该版本的 `settings.section` 槽位与 loader patch 机制开发； 宿主包名从此版本起为 `@deepseek-ai/*`）。 - **Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24`**：仅在本地构建 / 跑测试时需要；**直接安装不需要 Node**， 因为仓库里已提交构建产物 `lib/`。 - 安装完成后**必须重启 DSH**：MCP 改动由 loader 在启动时读取（技能、人设改动即时生效）。 ## 安装 三种方式任选其一；下面用 `desktop` profile 举例，**换成你自己的 profile 名**即可 （DSH 桌面版的默认 profile 就是 `desktop`）。 > **想直接把安装交给另一台电脑上的 AI？** 把仓库地址和 > [INSTALL.zh-CN.md](INSTALL.zh-CN.md) 一起发给它即可——那是一份逐条带「期望输出」的可执行 > runbook（环境探测 → 安装 → 重启 → 验证 → 网关配置 → 定时验收 → 故障排查 → 验收清单）。 ### 方式 0：一键脚本（自动探测 CLI 与 profile，已装则升级） ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2384418321/dsh-integration-settings/main/scripts/install.sh | bash # 也支持参数 / 本地副本： # bash scripts/install.sh --profile work --cli "/path/to/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" # bash scripts/install.sh --dry-run # 只看要执行什么 # Windows：powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install.ps1 ``` 脚本只调用 `dsh plugin add/update` 并打印验证清单，不删文件、不需要 sudo、不改系统路径。 ### 方式 A：从 GitHub 安装（推荐） ```bash # dsh CLI 在 DSH 应用目录里： # macOS /Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh # Windows 等 /resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh（Windows 上是 dsh.cmd） # 若已把 dsh 加入 PATH，直接写 dsh 也行；布局不同时可在安装目录里搜 runtime/cli DSH="/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" # 1) 安装：会登记依赖并把包名追加到 profile 的 dsh.profile.bundles "$DSH" plugin --profile desktop add github:2384418321/dsh-integration-settings # 2) 确认已登记（列表里出现 dsh-integration-settings 即成功） "$DSH" plugin --profile desktop list ``` 仓库直接提交了 `lib/` 构建产物，所以**从 GitHub 安装既不需要 npm 发布，也不需要本地构建**。 ### 方式 B：从本地目录安装（改源码调试用） ```bash git clone https://github.com/2384418321/dsh-integration-settings.git cd dsh-integration-settings pnpm install node scripts/build.mjs # 只有改了 src/ 才需要重跑 DSH="/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" "$DSH" plugin --profile desktop add "$(pwd)" # 本地目录以 link: 形式登记 ``` 以 `link:` 登记时，改完 `src/` 重跑 `node scripts/build.mjs` 再重启 DSH 即可，不必重装。 ### 方式 C：绕开 dsh CLI 手工登记 1. 在 profile 目录里安装（profile 目录：`$DSH_HOME/profiles/`）： ```bash cd "$HOME/.dsh/profiles/desktop" pnpm add github:2384418321/dsh-integration-settings ``` 2. 确认该目录 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组里**有** `"dsh-integration-settings"`（缺了就手工追加到数组末尾）。 3. 重启 DSH。 ### 安装完成后怎么确认 1. DSH 重启后，**设置**（Settings）左栏底部出现四项：`MCP 管理 / Skill 管理 / 全局人设 / 思考解锁`。 2. 打开「MCP 管理」，页面上方的 **profile 徽标**应显示你要操作的那个 profile 名； 多 profile 场景下先核对徽标，再动手改。 3. 已有 MCP 服务器应被列出；`cordis.patch.yml` 里手写但未被纳管的行会以横幅提示，可一键导入。 ## 卸载 ```bash DSH="/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" "$DSH" plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-integration-settings ``` 再从 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里删掉本包名，并（可选）清理 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中 `# >>> dsh-integration-settings:managed:mcp` 到 `# <<< dsh-integration-settings:managed:mcp` 之间的受管区块。 ## 故障排查 | 现象 | 原因 / 处理 | | --- | --- | | **页面所有接口 404**（`定时更新状态读取失败：请求失败（HTTP 404）`），且插件状态是 `pending` | 宿主 `inject` 声明了**运行时不存在的服务**：cordis 等不到服务，fiber 永远停在 `pending`，`apply()` 不执行 ⇒ 路由根本没注册。0.2.6 及更早版本在 `webRuntime` 被新版 DSH 删除后即触发此问题 | 升级到 **0.2.7 及以上**（`inject` 已收成 `['webServer','sessions']`），然后**完全重启** DSH | | `ERR_PNPM_GIT_DEP_PREPARE_NOT_ALLOWED` | pnpm 11 默认不执行 git 依赖的 `prepare` | 在 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 加 `allowBuilds:` + ` '<包名>': true`，再重跑安装 | | `sh: npm: command not found` / `spawnSync npx ENOENT` | 该 profile 里有依赖的 `prepare` 要跑 `npm install`，而这台机器没有 npm/npx | 装 Node.js（自带 npm/npx）后重试；细节见 [INSTALL.zh-CN.md](INSTALL.zh-CN.md) 第 7 节 | | 装完了，设置里没有这四个菜单 | ① 确认 `list` 与 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里有本包名；② 确认重启的是**同一个** profile；③ 若 bundle 加载失败，DSH 启动时会往 stderr 打 `: skipping profile bundle "dsh-integration-settings": <原因>` 并静默跳过——常见原因是改了 `src/` 没重新构建（`lib/` 缺失）、Node 版本过低或依赖解析失败 | | 点进菜单一片空白 | `settings.section` 是 root scope 槽位，一旦在条目里调用 seat 上的 session hook（`usePanelInfo` 等）就会触发 `Minified React error #311`，shell 会把整个槽位替换成 `
`。改客户端代码时请守「root scope 条目不调用任何 seat hook」这条（见下方设计要点） | | MCP 改了不生效 | profile patch 由 loader **启动时**读取：重启 DSH 后生效（页面上也有提示）。技能、人设改动即时生效 | | 写操作报 403 / 415 | 宿主路由要求写请求带 `x-dsh-integration: 1` 与 `application/json`；非 loopback / 不可信 Host、`Origin` 与 `Host` 不一致、`Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site` 一律 403 | | patch 写坏了想回滚 | 每次写入前都会在 profile 目录留时间戳备份（保留 3 份），改名覆盖回去即可；也可以只删掉两行标记之间的受管区块 | | 页面报 `ambiguous_profile` | 有多个 profile 的依赖里含本插件，无法唯一确定。用页面上的 profile 选择器指定，或设置 `DSH_PROFILE_DIR` / 传 `--profile <名>` | **数据与隐私**：插件不内置任何凭据。密钥请按下面的写法引用环境变量（`!!js process.env.X`）， 不要明文写进 patch；`.dsh-integration/` 是你的本机数据，已在 `.gitignore` 里排除。 ## 设计要点 ### MCP 管理 DSH 没有「MCP 注册表」这种东西：**一个 MCP 服务器就是 profile patch 里的一条 loader 行**。 ```yaml - insert: - id: mcp-github name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client' config: serverName: github # 工具名 => mcp__github__ transport: stdio # stdio | streamable-http command: npx args: ['-y', '@modelcontextprotocol/server-github'] env: { GITHUB_TOKEN: !!js process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN } ``` - 因为「新增未知 id 的 patch 条目」只有 `- insert:` 一种合法写法，所以本插件把 **受管区块整体重写**：JSON（`.dsh-integration/mcp.json`）是真理源，区块每次由它重新生成。 - 区块用两行标记注释包夹，`cordis.patch.yml` 里其它手写内容原样保留；写入前做 YAML 结构校验 + 时间戳备份（保留 3 份）。 - 已经在 patch 里手写、但插件还不认识的 MCP 行会在页面上以横幅提示，可一键导入纳管。 - `!!js` 表达式（例如 `!!js process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN`）在往返编辑中不会丢失，密钥不会落盘： `env` / `headers` 的任意层级值、以及 `args` 中以 `!!js ` 开头的元素都会被写成真正的 YAML 标签 （`TOKEN: !!js process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN`），普通字符串则保持原样；读回时又是字符串，往返无损。 - 若 profile 的 patch 文件是模板里的 `[]` 空占位，插件会在写入受管区块前先丢掉这行占位， 避免生成 `Unexpected seq-item-ind token` 这类非法 YAML。 ### 改的是哪个 profile？ 按以下顺序解析，尽量不猜（顺序：权威 → 显式 → 推断）： 1. 宿主服务 `ctx.get('desktopProfiles').current.dir`（桌面版里就是当前真正在用的 profile，最权威）； 2. 环境变量 `DSH_PROFILE_DIR`； 3. `--profile <名>` / `--profile=<名>` 参数或 `DSH_PROFILE` 环境变量（该 profile 目录需存在）； 4. 扫描 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/*`，找**唯一**一个依赖里含本插件的 profile； 5. 有多个候选时优先 `desktop`；仍无法唯一确定则报 `ambiguous_profile` 并提示手动指定，不会瞎写。 可在页面上方的 profile 徽标确认当前操作对象。 ### 设置页 seat 里的坑（改这个插件前必读） `settings.section` 是 **root scope** 槽位。shell 给每个条目的 props 里塞了一整套 seat 分享： `usePanelInfo`、`useSessions`、`useSessionStatus`、`useWorkspaces`、`useResource`、 `useSessionRetainInfo`、`renderFactorySlot`、`t`、`close`。 - **这些 `use*` 在 root scope 条目里调用会抛异常**（它们属于 session scope）。一旦把调用包在 `try/catch` 里把异常吞掉，React 的 hook 链就错位了，**下一次渲染**会在组件里第一个 `useState` 处抛 `Minified React error #311`；shell 有 per-entry 错误边界，会把整个 slot 换成 `
` —— 用户看到的就是「点进去空白」。 所以：**root scope 条目绝不调用 seat 上的任何 hook**，只用普通 prop（本插件的 `sessionIdOf` 只读 `props.sessionId`）。 - 更不能让 hook 调用顺序依赖 props 形状（第二个渲染时 props 变了 → "more/fewer hooks than during the previous render"，同样白屏）。 - `test/client-hooks.test.js` 专门守这两条：用计数版 React 直接驱动组件函数，断言 seat 上的 session hook **一次都没被调用**、且两套不同 props 下 hook 序列完全一致。改组件时别绕过它。 - 需要一次渲染看不出来的 bug 时，`renderToString` 抓不到 hook 顺序变化；用 `DSI_DEBUG=1 node scripts/build.mjs` 出**不压缩、保留函

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-desktop-bun

DeepSeek Harness 的原生桌面壳：**Electrobun（Bun 主进程）+ CEF（Blink/V8）渲染 + Bun 运行 dsh**。

一个安装包，自带 dsh 运行时，开箱即用；macOS（Apple Silicon）、Windows（x64）、Linux（x64）三平台 CI 出包。

## 特性

- **完整 dsh 桌面体验**：会话、插件、托盘、系统通知、防休眠、手机访问（lane 端口）、远程 dsh 接入。
- **多 profile 多窗口**：每个 profile 一个窗口、一份独立服务面；托盘聚焦/开关实例、新建与迁移 profile。
- **运行时管理**：内置随包运行时开箱即跑；也可下载/切换指定版本。
- **稳定的项目隔离**：每 profile 独立端口、独立窗口几何、独立服务进程；壳退出后不留孤儿进程。
- **原生窗口**：系统边框 + 自绘标题栏与三键（macOS/Windows 一致行为），站外链接走系统浏览器。

## 安装

从 [Releases](https://github.com/hyperion2144/dsh-desktop-bun/releases/latest) 下载：

| 平台 | 产物 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS（Apple Silicon） | `macos-arm64-DeepSeekHarnessDesktopBUN.dmg` |
| Windows（x64） | `windows-x64-DeepSeekHarnessDesktopBUN-setup.exe` |
| Linux（x64） | `linux-x64-DeepSeekHarnessDesktopBUN-Setup.tar.gz` |

安装与日常使用说明见 [GUIDE.md](desktop-electrobun/GUIDE.md)。

## 从源码构建

依赖：[Bun](https://bun.sh) 1.4+、[hutch](https://hutch.blackboard.sh)（Electrobun CLI）；Windows 安装器另需 NSIS。

```bash
git submodule update --init --recursive    # mobile/dsh-mobile-nav（手机布局插件 dsh-web-mobile）来自子模块，漏拉则构建断言失败
bun install --frozen-lockfile
node scripts/prepare-builtin-runtime.mjs --variant latest   # 装配随包 dsh 运行时
cd desktop-electrobun
bun run build        # 产物在 desktop-electrobun/artifacts/
bun test             # 单元 + 黑盒（需要真运行时树时设 DSH_SHELL_TEST_RUNTIME）
```

## 仓库结构

| 目录 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `desktop-electrobun/` | 壳本体（TypeScript / Bun / Electrobun） |
| `desktop-plugin/` | 桌面插件包 `dsh-desktop-bun`（壳 chrome 客户端 + 技能） |
| `plugins/dsh-mobile-access/` | 手机访问插件包（随包 staging） |
| `resources/` | Bun 兼容层（`dsh/bun-preload.mjs`）与图标 |

plugins.readme_text:
# 元冰可 · 企业 AI 资源管理平台

> 🎉 **We just launched on Product Hunt** — thanks for all the support!
> [YBK · Enterprise AI Asset Governance →](https://www.producthunt.com/posts/ybk-enterprise-ai-asset-governance)

[![Product Hunt](https://img.shields.io/badge/Product%20Hunt-Launch-Launch-orange)](https://www.producthunt.com/posts/ybk-enterprise-ai-asset-governance)


[![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)
[![selftest](https://img.shields.io/badge/selftest-1486%20green-success)](https://github.com/01men/ybkkasi/actions/workflows/quality-gate.yml)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node-%E2%89%A522.6-339933)]()
[![i18n](https://img.shields.io/badge/i18n-zh--en--ja-blue)]()
[![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/demo-demo.ybkkasi.com-FF6B35)](https://demo.ybkkasi.com)

**把散落在企业里的 MCP 服务 / Skill / Agent / AI 应用 / 模型渠道 / SaaS 连接器 / NAS 存储，
统一成一套可管、可算、可审的资产。**

一套身份 · 一套权限 · 一套计量 · 一套审计。**27 个插件包，按需启用。**

> **YBK Enterprise AI Asset Governance** — One control plane for every MCP server, skill,
> agent, and AI app. One identity, one permission model, one metering pipeline, one audit trail.
> Self-hosted, MIT licensed.

**[▶ 免登录在线体验](https://demo.ybkkasi.com)** · **[⬇ 60 秒本地启动](#60-秒跑起来)** · **[📖 文档](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)**

---

## 你可能正在经历这些

- MCP 服务散在各处，**没人说得清谁在用**
- Agent 拿着一把**万能 token 横冲直撞**
- 模型账单月底出来，**没人说得清哪个部门花的**
- 出了数据问题，**翻遍日志查不到审计记录**

元冰可把这些统一成「资产」，**从注册那一刻起就进入治理轨道**。

---

## 这和 AI Gateway 有什么不同

网关把 MCP 当作「一种要路由的流量」；
元冰可把 MCP / Skill / Agent 当作「**要被管生命周期的资产**」——
有状态机、有审批流、有逐工具最小权限声明、能按部门 / Agent / Skill 三个维度出成本报表。

| 层 | 代表方案 | 元冰可的位置 |
|---|---|---|
| AI/LLM Gateway | LiteLLM · Portkey · Higress · Bifrost | 不竞争，管流量路由 |
| LLMOps 可观测 | Langfuse · LangSmith · Braintrust | 不竞争，互补（我们缺 trace 深度） |
| Agent 构建平台 | Dify · Coze · FastGPT | 不构建，只治理已建成的 |
| **企业 AI 资产治理** | **这是一个刚被验证需求的新品类** | **✅ 这一层** |

---

## 60 秒跑起来

**Docker 一键体验**(推荐——打开即免登只读演示控制台):

```bash
docker compose up -d              # → http://localhost:7300(≤60 秒可访问,见演示数据)
```

`docker compose up` 自带 `DEMO_SEED=1 + DEMO_MODE=1`:首启注入完整演示数据,
访客**不注册不登录**直接浏览真实控制台(权限集为 26 个 `.read` 点白名单,
写操作 403/405,页面顶部有「演示模式 · 只读」横幅)。仅在演示实例开启 `DEMO_MODE`
——它会开放实例全部只读数据面,勿接真实业务数据。

**生产部署**(不带任何 `DEMO_*` 变量,行为与源码部署完全一致):

```bash
docker run -d --name ybkkasi -p 7300:7300 \
  -e ADMIN_PASSWORD='你的强口令' \
  -v ybkkasi-data:/app/data \
  ybkkasi:1.3.0
```

源码部署(要求 Node ≥ 22.6,原生 TypeScript 运行,无构建步骤;`node:sqlite` 为 Node 内置):

```bash
npm install && npm start          # → http://127.0.0.1:7300
```

生产基线默认:内置角色 + 根组织 + `admin` 账号(**无任何演示业务数据**)。
`admin` 口令取 `ADMIN_PASSWORD` 环境变量;未设置则随机生成并写入 `data/admin-initial-password.txt`。

想先看效果再读文档:

```bash
DEMO_SEED=1 npm start             # 注入演示数据(组织树/账号/MCP/Skill/Agent/应用/28 天历史)
# 演示账号 admin / ops / hr / dev / audit,口令均为 Ybk@2026
# 追加 DEMO_MODE=1 即开启免登只读演示态(同 Docker 体验形态)
```

企业单节点部署建议开启 SQLite 集合后端(数据完整性 / 内存有界,详见「诚实边界」):

```bash
PLATFORM_STORAGE=sqlite npm start # 业务集合切换 SQLite 后端(WAL + 事务,首启自动回填既有 JSON 数据)
```

```bash
npm run selftest                  # 1486 项端到端断言(隔离实例,全绿;含 SQLite 后端契约节)
npm run lint:manifests            # 插件清单五面 YAML 校验
```

要求 **Node ≥ 22.6**(原生 TypeScript 运行,无构建步骤;`node:sqlite` 为 Node 内置,零新增依赖)。

---

## 它管什么

大多数团队现在的状态是:MCP 服务散在各处没人知道谁在用、Agent 拿着万能 token 横冲直撞、
模型账单月底出来没人说得清哪个部门花的、出了问题查不到审计记录。

元冰可把这些**统一成"资产"**,每类资产共享同一套底座:

| 域            | 插件                                                                                                         | 能力                                                                 |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **身份**       | `plugin-iam` · `plugin-authn`                                                                              | 组织树 / 角色 / 用户组 / 三方连接器 · 双轨身份 + OIDC Provider + on-behalf-of 链     |
| **资产本体**     | `plugin-resource-core`                                                                                     | 属性 schema + 生命周期状态机 + 依赖图,所有资产类型的共同底座                              |
| **MCP**      | `plugin-mcp`                                                                                               | 部署 / 灰度 / 回滚 / 健康熔断 / 权限组 / 调用网关 / 监控(真实 HTTP JSON-RPC 传输层)        |
| **Skill**    | `plugin-skillhub`                                                                                          | 提交 → 静态扫描 → 两级审批 → 版本化上架                                           |
| **Agent**    | `plugin-agent`                                                                                             | Agent 本体管理(资源底座 + 机器凭证)                                            |
| **AI 应用**    | `plugin-app`                                                                                               | 编排拓扑 + 应用指标 + 成本穿透                                                 |
| **模型渠道**     | `plugin-modelgw`                                                                                           | OpenAI 兼容真实转发 · 分级路由 · 渠道组降级链 · 预算熔断                               |
| **SaaS 连接器** | `plugin-connector`                                                                                         | open-connector sidecar 数据面:Provider 目录 / OAuth 代理 / 凭证保险库 / 双层授权镜像 |
| **NAS 存储**   | `plugin-nas`                                                                                               | MCP 文件网关通道 / 组织位置 RBAC / 签名下载链接 / Skill 包直传                        |
| **计量**       | `plugin-usage`                                                                                             | 唯一计量入口 · schema v1 幂等 / 死信重放 / 价格簿 / 部门·Agent·Skill 三维聚合           |
| **审计**       | `plugin-audit`                                                                                             | 四类审计日志 + 告警规则 + 成本归集 + 审批中心                                        |
| **流程**       | `plugin-flow-core` · `plugin-exec-hub`                                                                     | 事务流编排 / SLA 与甘特 · 目标树、执行锁 CAS、心跳唤醒、例行调度                            |
| **数字员工**     | `plugin-workforce`                                                                                         | 员工档案 → 任用 → permit 授权 → 受控调用 → 交付验收                                |
| **市场**       | `plugin-market`                                                                                            | 第三方与自营插件市场(契约五面 / Ed25519 验签 / L0 运行时)                             |
| **接入层**      | `plugin-console` · `plugin-panel-core` · `plugin-dsh-bridge` · `plugin-rq-card` · `plugin-dingtalk-bridge` | REST 网关 + 控制台 SPA + 部门工作台面板 + 宿主桥 + 会话执行卡 + 钉钉桥接                   |

**这层的独特性**:市面上的 AI Gateway(LiteLLM / Higress / Portkey)把 MCP 当作**一种要路由的流量**;
元冰可把 MCP / Skill / Agent 当作**要被管生命周期的资产**——有状态机、有审批流、有逐工具最小权限声明、
能按部门 / Agent / Skill 三个维度出 token 报表。这两个是不同的层,不是一个替代关系。

---

## 架构:一切皆插件

运行中的平台就是一棵 [cordis](https://github.com/cordiverse/cordis) 插件树
(与 DeepSeek Harness 同一插件框架)。每个业务域 = 一个插件包,独立声明依赖 / 权限点 / 事件,可独立启停。
稳定入口见 [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)。

```
基础层   platform-core      存储 · 事件总线 · HTTP · ToolRuntime-lite · YAML · 签名 · 场景图谱
底座     resource-core      资源本体:schema + 生命周期状态机 + 依赖图
业务域   iam · authn · usage · audit · market · connector · mcp · nas · skillhub
         agent · app · modelgw · connect · update · portal · flow-core · exec-hub · workforce
接入层   console · panel-core · dsh-bridge · rq-card · dingtalk-bridge
```

**插件协作铁律**:状态变更必发事件;跨插件联动只走事件总线或扩展点(`ctx.platformBus`),
禁止直连对方数据。例如 `iam.user.frozen → authn 吊销全部令牌`、`mcp.unhealthy → 熔断 + 审计`。

### 一份插件代码,两种宿主

- **独立宿主**(默认,承诺 SLA 的形态)——`node src/main.ts` 启动完整平台:控制台 + API + 工具。
- **完整 dsh 运行时**(experimental)——同一批插件挂进 `dsh web`,此时平台注册的运维工具
  **直接对模型可见可调用**:在会话里问「列出所有 MCP 服务和健康状态」,模型会调
  `mcp_service_list`,而不是静态作答。这是"Agent 自运维"形态。

```bash
# 安装形态(推荐发布用)
dsh plugin --profile web add github:01men/ybkkasi

# 源码检出模式(本地开发)——需要把 cordis 指向 dsh 源码树的 vendor/cordis,
# 保证插件与宿主加载同一个 cordis 实例(两份实例会导致 ctx.plugin() 静默失效)
dsh web --patch <本项目绝对路径>/cordis.yml
```

> ⚠️ 宿主形态依赖 dsh `>=0.1.0-rc.7 <0.2.0`。dsh 目前仍是 developer preview,
> 官方明示会有破坏性变更。**独立宿主形态不依赖 dsh 版本稳定性**,是最稳的部署方式。
> 详见 [`docs/host-features-ops-notes.md`](docs/host-features-ops-no

plugins.description: Open-source, local-first envelope messaging for DeepSeek Harness: a TypeScript node, human-first inbox, explainable collaborator discovery, and bounded LAN recovery.
plugins.readme_text:
# Linko

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Linko is open-source, local-first envelope messaging for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It helps agents find the right collaborator, exchange scoped context, and continue a task under explicit human-controlled policies.

Linko is an early runnable MVP. The repository remains specification-driven: product boundaries, state transitions, delivery recovery, privacy rules, and architecture decisions are written beside the runtime.

## Why Linko

LAN messaging and approval panels are useful building blocks. Linko adds the part that becomes more useful with a person's own evidence and context:

- Each person and Agent can keep a subjective set of capability claims; later releases may attach signatures without creating a global reputation score.
- A task query can produce a local recommendation with evidence and an explanation.
- Context is shared by scope and purpose instead of being broadcast as a complete private history.
- A person can answer an inbound request, ask their Agent to draft a reply, or delegate a bounded response policy.
- Every delivery is a small envelope with a human-readable cover, machine-readable semantics, and an optional local body or safe surface.
- The experimental first group profile is capped at 500 member principals, with group delivery and message-layer E2EE as separate milestones.

## Project status

The MVP runs a SQLite-backed node and a human-first envelope inbox. It supports an explicit two-node HTTPS pairing profile with a durable outbox, pinned certificates, bearer authentication, retry-safe command IDs, and REST recovery. The local node also exposes an advisory loopback WebSocket for live UI hints; paired WSS delivery remains a later milestone. The replaceable TypeScript DSH companion bridge now provides `ask`, `inbox`, `inspect`, `draft`, `approve`, and `reply` adapters over the local API. Message signatures and E2EE remain later milestones; this is not a 20,000-node capacity claim.

- Product scope: [English](docs/specs/0001-product-scope.md) · [中文](docs/specs/0001-product-scope.zh.md)
- Architecture: [English](docs/architecture.md) · [中文](docs/architecture.zh.md)
- State and storage: [English](docs/specs/0005-state-and-storage.md) · [中文](docs/specs/0005-state-and-storage.zh.md)
- Review record: [English](docs/review.md) · [中文](docs/review.zh.md)
- Roadmap: [English](ROADMAP.md) · [中文](ROADMAP.zh.md)
- Decisions: [English](docs/decisions/README.md) · [中文](docs/decisions/README.zh.md)
- Local node MVP: [English](packages/node/README.md) · [中文](packages/node/README.zh.md)
- DSH companion bridge: [English](packages/bridge/README.md) · [中文](packages/bridge/README.zh.md)
- Envelope inbox UI: [English](packages/web/DESIGN.md) · [中文](packages/web/DESIGN.zh.md)

## Design direction

The first physical store is one SQLite database behind one TypeScript node. Immutable event content is durable; delivery attempts, read state, approvals, and notifications are local operational state. REST cursor synchronization and the SQLite outbox remain the canonical recovery path. The approved [2026 transport decision](docs/decisions/0010-wss-live-session-and-recovery.md) selects WSS as the online live session; its implementation remains pending. A graph can be materialized later as a view over claims; a graph database is not required.

The network uses ordinary IP and authenticated TCP/TLS connections, with explicit pairing. mDNS/DNS-SD is an optional discovery hint only; it does not grant trust or carry message bodies. Linko adds no application-layer router or payload flooding, and requires no Linko-specific router or switch feature. WebTransport/QUIC remain deferred experiments alongside DHT, Merkle synchronization, full-mesh sockets, blockchain consensus, and Rust/WASM; each needs a measured reason and a fallback test.

## DeepSeek Harness fit

Linko is intended to be a community plugin and companion protocol for the DeepSeek Harness ecosystem. It follows the Harness model that capabilities are composable plugins, while keeping the Linko protocol independently usable by other agents and clients.

## Contributing

Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and the repository guidance in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). Early contributions are most useful as design review, threat modeling, interoperability experiments, and small protocol fixtures.

## Topics

The repository is indexed with dsh, dsh-plugin, deepseek-harness, agent-collaboration, local-first, lan-messaging, envelope-messaging, human-in-the-loop, sqlite, typescript, and pnpm.

plugins.description: Session deletion for DeepSeek Harness: recoverable trash-based delete, a sidebar menu row, and session_delete / session_restore agent tools.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-delete

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

[![test](https://github.com/hakulat2023/dsh-session-delete/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/hakulat2023/dsh-session-delete/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0b7285)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

Session **deletion** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

DeepSeek Harness can archive a Session, but archiving only hides it — there is no way to get rid of
one. This plugin adds that missing verb: **Delete session** in the Session row's “…” menu, a
`remote.sessionDelete` host namespace, and the `session_delete` / `session_restore` agent tools.

Deletion is deliberately **recoverable**: the Session's durable log is moved into a local trash
directory, so a mistake costs a `mv`, not a conversation.

- [What it does](#what-it-does)
- [Requirements](#requirements)
- [Install](#install)
- [Use](#use)
- [Configuration](#configuration)
- [Semantics and limits](#semantics-and-limits)
- [Development](#development)
- [Verified behaviour](#verified-behaviour)
- [License](#license)

## What it does

One deletion performs four steps:

1. **Admission.** The Session is asked the same questions archiving asks, through the
   `workspace/session-activity` waterfall. Live work is refused unless the caller allows a stop;
   when it is, `workspace/session-stop` cancels the turn and the plugin waits (bounded) for the
   Session to go idle. A Session still resident in the host process is refused *before any side
   effect* and only deleted after a second, explicit confirmation.
2. **Trash the log.** The Session's own directory is handed to the **platform's own trash** — the
   Finder's Trash on macOS, the XDG trash on Linux, the Recycle Bin on Windows — as
   `<sessionId>-<timestamp>`, carrying a `trash.json` record with the title, `cwd`, original
   directory, byte/file counts, and deletion time. `purge: true` deletes it outright instead.
   A small record is also written under `$DSH_HOME/session-delete/entries/` (entry path plus original
   directory, **no Session content**), because macOS refuses to let a process *enumerate* `~/.Trash`
   (TCC): without it a trashed Session could not be found again. See
   [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md).
3. **Drop the registrations.** The Session is detached from every Workspace account
   (`sessionIds`), removed from the registry-global archive and pin sets, and its projection-cache
   record is deleted.
4. **Tell the UI.** `api-session/removed` is emitted, so every connected browser drops the row
   immediately.

The Session directory is located through the persistence backend's own `locate(header)` when it
offers one, so a backend that changes its on-disk layout does not need a plugin update; otherwise the
plugin falls back to the documented `sessions/<projectKey(cwd)>/<encodeSegment(id)>` layout.

## Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.x` (developed and verified against `0.2.0-rc.2`) |
| Node.js | `>= 20` |
| Surface | any profile that mounts the Session store, the JSONL persistence backend, the Workspace registry, and the Web client (`dsh-web-app` / desktop) |

The plugin has **no npm dependencies** and **no build step**: the browser half is a hand-written
module in the `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` shape the Web client already consumes,
and the host half imports nothing outside `node:*`. See
[docs/plugin-packaging.md](docs/plugin-packaging.md) for why that matters for third-party plugins.

## Install

The package is a DSH **bundle**: `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and `dsh.client`, and
`cordis.patch.yml` inserts the host row.

```bash
# from a local checkout (this repository)
plugin_manager install_bundle   target: /absolute/path/to/dsh-session-delete

# or from GitHub, by tag, with the bundled CLI
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:hakulat2023/dsh-session-delete#v0.1.0

# or from the registry, once published
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-session-delete
```

The bundle patch that gets mounted is one row:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: session-delete
      name: dsh-session-delete
```

After installing, **restart the application once**. The host half is a Node ESM module and the
running process keeps the module generation it already loaded (DSH's own limitation: a replaced
package needs a restart to load fresh JavaScript). The browser half is served from disk and only
needs a page reload.

## Use

### Web UI

Session row → **“…”** → **Delete session** → confirm.

- A **running** Session is stopped first: the first confirmation already carries that intent.
- A Session that is still **resident** in the host (typically the one you have open) is described as
  such and needs a second confirmation; the first click has no side effect at all.
- On success the row disappears everywhere and a toast reports the outcome **and the trash directory**
  (a Session whose log was already gone is reported as such, never as a move).

### Agent tools

| Tool | Arguments | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `session_delete` | `session_id` (required), `stop_activity` (default `true`), `force` (default `false`), `purge` (default `false`) | Moves the Session to the trash; `purge: true` deletes the bytes permanently instead. |
| `session_restore` | `session_id` (required) | Moves a trashed Session directory back to its original location. |

### Remote namespace

`remote.sessionDelete.delete({ sessionId, stopActivity?, force?, purge? })` and
`remote.sessionDelete.restore({ sessionId })` — the same operations the UI dialog uses.

### Restoring by hand

A trashed Session is an ordinary directory in the platform's trash:

| Platform | Where it went | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| macOS | `~/.Trash/<sessionId>-<timestamp>/` | Finder shows it; “Put Back” is not offered (Finder did not move it), but `session_restore` works |
| Linux | `$XDG_DATA_HOME/Trash/files/…` with its `.trashinfo` | the desktop's own “Restore” works as well |
| Windows | the Recycle Bin | the plugin cannot read the bin back, so restore it by hand |

```bash
cat ~/.Trash/<sessionId>-*/trash.json      # originalDirectory, title, cwd, sizes
```

`session_restore(session_id)` puts it back and withdraws both records; the Session reappears in the
list once the Workspace registry next indexes stored headers (a reload, or the next launch).

## Configuration

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `trash` | `"system"` | Destination: `"system"` uses the platform's own trash, `"directory"` uses `trashRoot`, and any other string is taken as an absolute directory. |
| `trashRoot` | `$DSH_HOME/session-trash` | The directory used by `trash: directory` (and by `trashRoot` alone, for 0.1 compatibility). |
| `restoreIndexRoot` | `$DSH_HOME/session-delete` | Where the restore records live (`entries/<entry name>.json`). Metadata only — never Session content. |

```yaml
# keep the platform trash (the default): nothing to configure
- id: session-delete
  name: dsh-session-delete

# or own the destination, e.g. on a machine whose ~/.Trash is undesirable
- id: session-delete
  name: dsh-session-delete
  config:
    trash: directory
    trashRoot: /Volumes/big/dsh-session-trash
```

## Semantics and limits

- **Your trash, your decision.** Deleted Sessions land in the platform's trash and stay there until
  *you* empty it; the plugin never empties it, and it leaves no trash directory of its own behind.
- **macOS will not let a process list `~/.Trash`.** Moving in, reading a known entry, and moving it
  back out all work; `readdir` is refused by TCC. That is the only reason a restore record exists —
  `session_restore` follows the record instead of searching the trash. Emptying the trash makes the
  record stale, and a stale record is pruned rather than reported as a failure.
- **Windows restore is manual.** The Recycle Bin has no consumer-facing API for finding an entry
  again, so `session_delete` reports `trashedTo: null` and `session_restore` explains that the folder
  has to be restored f

plugins.description: DSH host plugin: detect long tasks (long-output & multi-step) and auto-split them for small-context local models - parts skeleton or PLAN.md ledger plus injected execution rules.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-task-splitter

**A DSH host plugin that notices long tasks and splits them before they fail — built for small-context local models.**

[中文说明见下方](#中文说明)

Small local models (llama.cpp / Ollama, e.g. Qwen3 27B at IQ2 with `maxTokens: 8192`) fail long tasks in two
*completely different* ways. This plugin detects both on the **host side** and hands the model an executable
procedure, instead of hoping the model judges its own limits.

| | **Lane A — long output** | **Lane B — long workflow** |
|---|---|---|
| Example | "write a 3000-word industry report, 4 sections" | **"pick me a stock likely to rise tomorrow"** |
| Prompt shape | usually explicit | **often tiny** ("pick me a…") |
| Real bottleneck | the per-request output budget (`maxTokens`) | **step count and context**: tool output floods the window, a small model drifts, intermediate results get lost |
| What this plugin does | scaffolds `tasks/<slug>/parts/NN-*.md` + `MANIFEST.json`; one part per reply, then `assemble` | scaffolds `tasks/<slug>/PLAN.md` + `notes/`; **plan first, one step per reply, results on disk** |

## How it decides

Scoring runs in the host (no model cooperation needed):

- **Lane A signals** — explicit word/char count, explicit part count, numbered section list (used as part titles),
  long-document keywords + a writing verb, very long prompt, multi-deliverable phrasing.
- **Lane B signals** — decision/research verbs (pick / recommend / evaluate / compare / analyse / predict / research / screen)
  **plus** a data-dependent domain noun (stocks, funds, housing, flights, insurance, papers, competitors, laptop…),
  explicit multi-step phrasing, or "needs current external data".
- Single-lookup requests ("what's the weather tomorrow") are deliberately clamped below the threshold.

Examples:

| Prompt | Result |
|---|---|
| `what's the weather` | no split |
| `look up tomorrow's weather for me` | no split (single lookup) |
| `recommend me a movie` | no split (score 2 < 3) |
| **`pick me a stock likely to rise tomorrow`** | **Lane B** → `PLAN.md` + `notes/`, "plan first, one step per reply" |
| `compare these three laptops and pick one` | **Lane B** |
| `write a 3000-word industry report, 4 parts` | **Lane A** → 4-part skeleton |
| a prompt with a 1./2./3. section list | **Lane A** (part titles taken from the list) |

The procedure is injected with `agent/pre-step` **prepended to the very same request** (no extra round trip),
and only for steps that start from a human message.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-task-splitter
```

Restart DSH afterwards. To build from source: `npm pack` then
`dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add file:./dsh-task-splitter-0.1.0.tgz`.

Requires a DSH host that exposes `agent/pre-step`, `ctx.agents` and `ctx.sessions`
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent` / `dsh-session` `^0.1.1-rc.2 || ^0.2.0-rc.1`).

## Configuration

```yaml
# in your profile cordis patch (or a home patch)
- id: task-splitter
  config:
    enabled: true
    providers: [qwen-local]   # empty array = every provider
    lanes: [parts, plan]      # drop one to disable that lane
    minScore: 3               # Lane A threshold
    workflowScore: 3          # Lane B threshold (raise to 4 to be more conservative)
    maxParts: 8               # Lane A: at most this many parts
    wordsPerPart: 900         # Lane A: target chars per part
    tasksDir: tasks           # relative to the session working directory
    toolPath: ''              # CLI used in the injected rules; defaults to the bundled one
    extraRules: ''            # 追加到注入规程末尾的补充说明（放环境特定的工具名/服务地址）
```

## Bundled CLI

`dsh-task-parts` (also exported as `dsh-task-splitter/task-parts`) drives Lane A outside the model:

```bash
node bin/task-parts.mjs init <taskDir> --title "T" --parts "one|two|three"
node bin/task-parts.mjs status <taskDir>     # ✅/⬜ per part, exits 2 while incomplete
node bin/task-parts.mjs next <taskDir>       # the next part to write
node bin/task-parts.mjs assemble <taskDir>   # concatenates into final.md
```

## Limitations (please read)

- Lane B guarantees **process and honesty** (plan, evidence on disk, sources, uncertainty, "do not fabricate data"),
  **not** the correctness of the answer. A local model with no market/financial data source cannot honestly predict
  tomorrow's stock move — the procedure makes it say so instead of inventing numbers.
- Detection is heuristic. `workflowScore` / `minScore` are the knobs; the plugin never blocks a turn — worst case it
  adds one short instruction message.
- Tested against a Windows DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 host with llama.cpp-served Qwen3; 27 offline simulation cases ship in
  [`test-sim.mjs`](./test-sim.mjs) (not included in the npm tarball).

## License

MIT

---

## 中文说明

**DSH 宿主插件：在长任务失败之前识别它并拆开 —— 为小上下文本地模型而做。**

本地小模型（llama.cpp / Ollama，例如 `maxTokens: 8192` 的 Qwen3-27B IQ2）会在**两类完全不同的**长任务上翻车，
本插件在**宿主侧**把两类都识别出来，并交给模型一套可执行的规程，而不是指望模型自己判断极限。

| | **车道 A：产出型** | **车道 B：流程型** |
|---|---|---|
| 例子 | "写一篇 3000 字的行业报告，分 4 部分" | **"帮我选一只明天大概率会涨的股票"** |
| 提示词 | 通常明确 | **可能极短** |
| 真正瓶颈 | 单次输出预算（`maxTokens`） | **步骤数与上下文**：工具结果塞满窗口、小模型多步跑偏、中间结果丢失 |
| 插件动作 | 建 `tasks/<slug>/parts/NN-*.md` + `MANIFEST.json`；每轮只写一段，最后 `assemble` | 建 `tasks/<slug>/PLAN.md` + `notes/`；**先立计划、每轮一步、结果落盘** |

判定在宿主侧打分（不依赖模型自觉）：车道 A 看字数/分段/分节列表/长文关键词/超长提示词；
车道 B 看**决策研究类动词 + 依赖数据的领域名词**、显式多步措辞、是否需要实时外部信息；
单次查询类（"帮我查一下天气"）会被压到阈值以下。

规程通过 `agent/pre-step` **前置到同一次请求**里（不额外耗一轮），且只处理以人类消息开始的那一步。

安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add dsh-task-splitter
```

装完重启 DSH。配置项同上（`lanes` / `minScore` / `workflowScore` / `maxParts` / `wordsPerPart` / `tasksDir` / `toolPath`）。

**局限**：车道 B 保证的是**过程与诚实性**（计划、证据落盘、来源、不确定性、禁止编造数据），**不保证答案正确**；
本地没有行情/财务数据源时，它就该说"给不出可靠结论"，而不是编数字。检测是启发式的，
`workflowScore` / `minScore` 可调；最坏情况只是多注入一条很短的指令，不会阻塞任何一轮。

MIT 许可。

# dsh-token-chart

一个 **DeepSeek Harness** 插件：把本机会话的 Token 用量采集下来，以图表与统计的形式放回你正在用的界面里——会话抽屉、每日面板、可自由配置的图表形式。交互参考 DSH 产品自带的「用量」，数据口径与它一致（计费口径，含缓存重读）。

![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%E2%89%A5%200.2.0--rc.2-1c3c3c.svg)
![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A5%2020-339933.svg)
![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-007ec6.svg)

## 🚀 快速开始

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-token-chart
```

> 安装的是发布时预构建好的产物（`lib/` 已构建好），在你的机器上不执行任何构建脚本；用量数据全部留在本机，不上报任何遥测。装好之后怎么用见 [使用指南](#-使用指南)。

## 📖 使用指南

### 三个入口

| 位置 | 入口 | 内容 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 左侧边栏 | 「Token 用量」菜单 | 今天 / 近 3 天 / 近 7 天 / 近 30 天：KPI 卡片 + 趋势图 + 分页表格 |
| 会话标题栏 | 「用量」小按钮（与 ⋯ 菜单同一行，**常驻**） | 右侧边栏抽屉：总 Token、输入/输出、缓存读取/写入、命中率、轮次、模型 + 逐轮趋势图 |
| 设置页 | 设置 →「Token 用量」 | 图表形式、展示指标、开关；标题行含插件版本与「更新版本」按钮 |

页面上会出现三个「用量」入口，它们彼此独立，各由不同的东西控制：

| 你看到的「Token 用量」 | 由什么控制 |
| --- | --- |
| 消息底部 / 输入框上方的「用量」胶囊 | 产品自身的组件；插件只拦截点击，把它改成打开本抽屉（开关：**拦截产品用量按钮**） |
| 会话标题栏右上角的小按钮 | 本插件注册在 `conversation.session.header.utilities` 的入口，**常驻显示**（不设开关） |
| 右侧边栏的标签页标题 | 本插件的 `sidebar.right.pane.tab.title` 座位，**不受**上面那个开关影响 |

### 图表形式与交互

图表形式有 7 种：柱状、折线、饼图、表格、多柱状、多折线、柱状折线组合，会话抽屉与每日面板可以分别配置。

- **缓存命中率叠加**：柱状 / 折线 / 多柱状 / 多折线 / 组合图都可在右轴叠加一条命中率折线（默认开）。
- **范围选择条**：坐标轴下方的 dataZoom，拖动两端或中间窗口即可只看某一段 x 范围（滚轮与触控板捏合同样生效）。缩放只改变可见窗口，不改统计口径——数据表、KPI 卡片与总量始终是完整区间的值。
- **分页数据表**：默认每页 20 条，页大小用下拉切换（10 / 20 / 50），页码为数字按钮 + 省略号（`1 … 4 5 [6] 7 8 … 50`），整条分页栏常驻右下角。切换页大小或数据变化会回到第一页。

x 轴按视图区分，口径如下：

| 视图 | x 轴 | 一个点是什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 每日面板「今天」 | 时间 `HH:mm`（同分钟多轮自动补到 `HH:mm:ss`） | 一轮的用量 |
| 每日面板「近 3 / 7 / 30 天」 | 日期 | 一天 |
| 会话抽屉 | `#轮次` | 会话内的一轮 |

### 配置

配置在**设置 →「Token 用量」**里改，落盘到 `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-token-chart/prefs.json`（默认 `~/.dsh/...`）。

| 字段 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sessionChart` | 枚举 | `multi-bar` | 会话抽屉的图表形式 |
| `dailyChart` | 枚举 | `multi-bar` | 每日面板的图表形式 |
| `sessionMetrics` | 数组 | `["input","output","cache","total"]` | 会话抽屉展示的指标 |
| `dailyMetrics` | 数组 | `["input","output","cache","total"]` | 每日面板展示的指标 |
| `showTable` | 布尔 | `true` | 图表下方是否渲染数据表 |
| `showCacheHitRate` | 布尔 | `true` | 组合图是否叠加缓存命中率折线 |
| `interceptUsageButton` | 布尔 | `true` | 点击产品「用量」胶囊时打开本插件抽屉 |

枚举值：`bar` / `line` / `pie` / `table` / `multi-bar` / `multi-line` / `bar-line`；指标值：`input` / `output` / `cache` / `total`。非法值会被 `normalizePrefs()` 丢弃并回退到默认，不会让界面挂掉。

### 数据与口径

- 数据目录：`$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-token-chart/`（默认 `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-token-chart/`），`usage.json` 是用量库，`prefs.json` 是界面偏好。
- **只保留最近 30 个自然日**，更早的轮次在每次落盘前滚动丢弃（超出窗口的会话会被整条移除）。
- **幂等采集**：按 `(轮次, 步骤, 重试世代)` 存槽位，重放会话日志不重复计数；存储 schema 不符时丢弃并从日志重建。
- **会话总量**取会话级折叠，而不是把逐轮数字相加；运行时还会与产品的 `tokenUsage` 投影交叉校验，不一致时抽屉里会显式提示。
- **口径提醒**：这里的「总 Token」是计费口径——每次请求的上下文（含缓存重读）都计入，所以一个约 1.5M 上下文的会话跑 350 步会得到约 150M；它不是「上下文大小」。
- **网络**：唯一的出网行为是版本检查（profile 的 `.npmrc` registry，缺省 `https://registry.npmmirror.com/`，宿主侧缓存 30 分钟、超时 12 秒）；用量数据只写本机。

### 进阶：用 HTTP API 读写

宿主半边在 Harness 的 web server 上提供这些路由（`/token-chart/api` 前缀），脚本与外部工具可以直接用：

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/token-chart/api/health` | 采集器状态（保留天数、已跟踪会话数、偏好是否加载、回填是否完成） |
| GET | `/token-chart/api/prefs` | 读取配置（含默认值） |
| POST | `/token-chart/api/prefs` | 保存配置补丁 |
| GET | `/token-chart/api/overview?range=today\|3d\|7d\|30d` | 区间统计（按天分桶 + 今天逐轮明细；未知区间回退到 `today`） |
| GET | `/token-chart/api/session?sessionId=…` | 单会话逐轮用量 |
| GET | `/token-chart/api/version` | 插件版本、registry 最新版与更新状态 |
| POST | `/token-chart/api/update` | 触发一次版本更新 |
| POST | `/token-chart/api/reset` | 清空本地用量库 |

改配置（补丁式，只写要改的键）：

```bash
curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:19387/token-chart/api/prefs \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"dailyChart":"bar-line","showCacheHitRate":false}'
```

## ✨ 特性

- **会话抽屉**：单个会话的逐轮用量趋势 + 文字统计，从会话标题栏一键打开。
- **每日面板**：今天 / 近 3 天 / 近 7 天 / 近 30 天四个区间，KPI + 趋势图 + 数据表。
- **7 种图表形式**：柱状、折线、饼图、表格、多柱状、多折线、柱状折线组合，会话与面板可分别配置。
- **缓存命中率叠加**：柱状 / 折线 / 多柱状 / 多折线 / 组合图都可在右轴叠加命中率折线（默认开）。
- **范围选择条**：坐标轴下方的 dataZoom，拖动只看某一段 x 范围；缩放不改变统计口径（KPI、总量、表格始终是完整区间）。
- **分页数据表**：默认 20 条/页，页大小 10 / 20 / 50 下拉切换，页码为数字按钮 + 省略号，常驻右下角。
- **接管产品「用量」胶囊**：点击改为打开本插件抽屉，而不是产品自带的对话框（可关）。
- **口径与产品一致**：总 Token 采用计费口径（每次请求的上下文含缓存重读都计入）；运行时与产品的 `tokenUsage` 投影交叉校验，不一致会在抽屉里显式提示。
- **幂等采集**：按 `(轮次, 步骤, 重试世代)` 存槽位，重放会话日志不重复计数；存储 schema 不符时丢弃并从日志重建。
- **降级可用**：ECharts chunk 拉取失败（离线、被拦、产物损坏）时自动回退到内置自绘 SVG，界面不会空掉。
- **零运行时依赖**：宿主半边不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*`，浏览器半边只把 react 平台种子留作 external，安装不需要 peer 解析或共享实例授权。
- **懒加载图表库**：启动只需 ~70 KB 的 `client.js`（gzip 20 KB），首次出图才拉 618 KB 的 ECharts chunk（gzip 234 KB）。
- **可热更新**：设置页自动查一次新版本（30 分钟缓存），有新版时给出「更新版本」按钮，走 `ctx.pluginManager.installBundle`。

## 🛠 本地开发与调试

源码全部是 TypeScript（浏览器半边 TSX + JSX automatic runtime）；`src/` 是唯一事实来源，**一切产物落在 `lib/` 且不入 git**。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lugezuishuai/dsh-token-chart.git && cd dsh-token-chart
npm install              # 触发 prepare：全量构建出 lib/
npm run typecheck        # 两个工程分别类型检查（宿主 + 浏览器）
npm run build            # 清空 lib/ 后全量重建
npm run check            # 发布门禁：typecheck + build + preflight + 宿主用例
```

| 命令 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run build:host` / `:styles` / `:client` / `:chunk` | 单独重跑某一段（tsc / tailwind+less / esbuild / esbuild） |
| `npm run preflight` | 产物与元数据自检：loader id、包名、四件产物、registry、lockfile |
| `npm run test:host` | 宿主套件：折叠语义、跨天分桶、配置校验、落盘、版本检查 |
| `npm run test:client` | 浏览器套件：jsdom 加载**真实产物**，通过 HTTP 连**运行中的** Harness |
| `npm run format` | prettier：`src/**`、`tests/**`、`scripts/**` |

调试期建议隔离数据目录，避免污染真实用量库：

```bash
DSH_HOME=$(mktemp -d) npm run test:host     # 宿主用例必须用独立 DSH_HOME

# 浏览器用例需要运行中的 Harness（默认 http://127.0.0.1:19387）与一个真实会话 id
DSH_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:19387 DSH_SESSION_ID=<session-id> npm run test:client
```

| 环境变量 | 作用 | 默认 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DSH_HOME` | 数据根目录（`usage.json` / `prefs.json` 在其下） | `~/.dsh` |
| `DSH_ORIGIN` | 浏览器用例连接的 Harness 地址 | `http://127.0.0.1:19387` |
| `DSH_SESSION_ID` | 浏览器用例打开的会话 | 内置一个示例 id |
| `REACT_DIR` / `JSDOM_DIR` | 用例解析 `react` / `jsdom` 的目录 | npx 缓存目录 |

> 浏览器用例会在跑前快照、跑后恢复你的真实偏好；jsdom 没有 canvas 与布局，脚本会补 `HTMLCanvasElement.getContext` 与 `clientWidth` 垫片，浏览器端不需要。

让宿主半边也热加载（默认只热替换浏览器半边）：把插件目录加进 profile 的 hmr 监听根，改 `src/**` 重建后即时生效，无需重启。

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- id: hmr
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-hmr'
  config:
    root:
      - /path/to/dsh-token-chart
```

> 构建请用你自己的 Node（本机为 `~/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.0`）。DSH 自带的 Node 在 macOS 上无法 dlopen tailwind 的 `lightningcss` 原生模块，`build:styles` 会失败。

## 📦 构建与发布

构建产物与 DSH 包契约一一对应，全部落在 `lib/`：

| 产物 | 生成方式 | 被谁读 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lib/index.js` + `lib/*.js` | `tsc`（`package.json#main`） | DSH 宿主进程 |
| `lib/types/*.d.ts` | `tsc`（`package.json#types`） | 消费方类型检查 |
| `lib/client.js` | `esbuild` → `__ModuleLoader__` CJS 工厂（**不压缩**，逐行可审阅） | 浏览器（`exports["./client"]`） |
| `lib/client.echarts.js` | `esbuild` → 压缩、自包含的懒加载 chunk | 浏览器（`require.async`） |
| `lib/token-chart.css` | `tailwindcss` + `lessc` | 浏览器（宿主路由下发） |

```bash
npm run check            # 发布门禁：typecheck + build + preflight + 宿主用例
npm pack                 # prepack 自动重建 + preflight，然后打包
npm version patch        # 版本号即 tag，更新检查按版本号比较，两者务必一致
npm publish              # publishConfig 固定发往 registry.npmjs.org
```

发布也可以交给 CI：[.github/workflows/release.yml](.github/workflows/release.yml) 在**推送到 main**（含 PR 合并）与**手动触发**时运行——跑门禁 → 版本还不在 npm 上就自动发布、打 `v<version>` tag、建 GitHub Release；版本已存在则只跑门禁。认证走 **npm Trusted Publishing（OIDC）**，仓库里不存任何 npm token；预发布版本按 preid 走独立 dist-tag（`0.1.1-rc.1` → `rc`），不会顶掉 `latest`。

发布流水线要点：

1. **`prepack` = 全量构建 + `scripts/preflight.mjs`**，因此 tarball 一定带着四件产物与 `lib/types`；产物不进 git，`files` 白名单决定包内容。
2. **安装与发布都走 npmjs 源站**：项目 `.npmrc` 与 `package.json#publishConfig.registry` 都指向 `https://registry.npmjs.org/`——镜像是只读的、不接受发布，统一在源站可以让"消费者装到的版本"与"发布出去的版本"始终一致。
3. **preflight 检查**：包名与 loader id 一致（改名事故的护栏）、四件产物存在、`cordis.patch.yml` 按包名插入、`private` 已移除、`engines.dsh` 已声明、lockfile 不含内网/私有 registry。

三种分发方式的产物来源：

| 分发方式 | 产物从哪来 |
| --- | --- |
| npm / tarball | 发布机上的 `prepack` 预构建，消费者零构建 |
| git 安装 | 消费者机器上的 `prepare` 现场构建（需先授权构建脚本） |
| 本地 link | 工作区里的 `lib/`，由你 `npm run build` 产出 |
